reflection.en: The news highlights the agonizing uncertainty faced by families awaiting word of 43 missing Australians in Nepal. As each day and hour passes, the weight of not knowing intensifies their distress. This enduring crisis calls to mind the steadfast mercy of Yahweh, which is renewed each morning, offering a glimmer of hope even amidst prolonged suffering.
reflection.zh: 新闻报道了在尼泊尔失踪的43名澳大利亚人的家人所面临的痛苦的不确定性。随着每一天、每一小时的过去，未知带来的重担加剧了他们的痛苦。这场持续的危机让人想起雅伟那永恒不变的慈爱，它每天早晨都得以更新，即使在长久的苦难中也带来一丝希望。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

body.en: Resignation comes after months of turmoil at Pentagon, from leaked investigation to ousting of senior officials Army secretary Dan Driscoll has handed his resignation to Donald Trump, the White House said on Monday, becoming the latest high-profile figure to depart the defense department. The army official, who is second in line to defense secretary Pete Hegseth, had reportedly been eyeing an exit from the Pentagon amid apparent friction with the secretary. Continue reading...
body.zh: 白宫周一表示，五角大楼经历了从调查泄密到高级官员被罢黜等数月的动荡，陆军部长丹·德里斯科尔已向唐纳德·特朗普递交辞呈，成为最新一位离开国防部的高调人物。据报道，这位陆军官员是国防部长皮特·赫格斯的第二顺位，由于与国防部长明显发生摩擦，他一直在考虑退出五角大楼。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The resignation of Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, reportedly due to friction with his superior, underscores the challenges of leadership and the importance of integrity in public service. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that righteous rulers maintain stability and uphold justice, a standard that leaders are called to pursue even amidst internal disagreements.

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.

title.en: US Supreme Court clears way for Trump to keep building White House ballroom
title.zh: 美国最高法院为特朗普继续建造白宫宴会厅铺平道路

summary.en: The US Supreme Court has allowed construction of a $400 million ballroom at the White House to proceed, overriding lower court decisions that had halted the project. Chief Justice John Roberts dissented, arguing the construction is likely unlawful due to a lack of congressional approval, as raised by the National...
summary.zh: 美国最高法院已允许在白宫建造耗资4亿美元的宴会厅，推翻了此前叫停该项目的下级法院裁决。首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨持不同意见，认为国会未批准该项目，因此建造可能属非法，这是历史保护国家信托基金提出的质疑。

body.en:
The US Supreme Court has ruled that construction of a $400m (£297m) ballroom at the White House can go ahead, in a victory for President Donald Trump.

In a 5-4 ruling, the justices granted the Trump administration's emergency request, blocking lower court rulings that would have halted construction of an above-ground portion of the project.

But Chief Justice John Roberts, a conservative, sided with the three liberal justices to dissent, writing that "construction is likely unlawful" because Congress has not approved the project.

The National Trust for Historic Preservation filed the legal challenge, arguing that the president did not have unilateral authority to proceed with construction.

Trump demolished the historic East Wing of the executive residence last autumn to begin building the ballroom. The White House has said the project will be "substantially" finished by November and fully completed by August 2028.

On Friday, the high court had temporarily allowed construction of the 90,000 sq ft (8,400 sq m) ballroom to move forward while the justices considered the lawsuit aiming to halt it entirely.

In Monday's unsigned order, the five justices who cleared the way for construction said lower courts had "likely exceeded" their authority in blocking the ballroom.

While the majority did not decide on the legality of the East Wing project, they said the preservation group "lacks standing" to sue the government.

They ruled that the Trump administration had established it was likely to succeed in arguing that it would "suffer irreparable harm without a stay".

Chief Justice Roberts wrote in dissent: "Today's decision is no victory for the separation of powers."

Reacting to the ruling, Trump posted that he was "pleased" the "baseless" lawsuit had failed to halt construction.

"We are living in the Golden Age of America, and this Building will be one of the Greatest ever constructed in Washington, DC," he said.

Trump has long argued that the White House needs a larger events space, and more recently, that it was important for his security.

The Republican president emphasised the need for the ballroom after an alleged assassination attempt at the White House Correspondents' Association dinner in April.

But the National Trust for Historic Preservation argued that construction was causing irreversible damage to a historical landmark.

Its position stemmed from a declaration made by preservationist Alison Hoagland, who lives in Washington DC and serves on the trust's board of trustees.

Hoagland, who says she visits the neighbourhood once a month, asserted that she would "suffer both professional and personal injuries, including to my aesthetic, cultural and historical interests, if a ballroom of the proposed form and scale were constructed".

body.zh: 美国最高法院裁定，可以继续在白宫建造一座耗资 4 亿美元（2.97 亿英镑）的宴会厅，这是唐纳德·特朗普总统的胜利。 大法官以 5 比 4 的裁决批准了特朗普政府的紧急请求，阻止了下级法院停止该项目地上部分建设的裁决。 但首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨（John Roberts）是一位保守派人士，他站在三位自由派法官的立场上提出异议，他写道，“建设可能是非法的”，因为国会尚未批准该项目。 国家历史保护信托基金提出了法律挑战，认为总统无权单方面进行建设。 去年秋天，特朗普拆除了行政官邸历史悠久的东翼，开始建造宴会厅。白宫表示，该项目将于 11 月“基本”完成，并于 2028 年 8 月全面完成。 周五，高等法院暂时允许这座 90,000 平方英尺（8,400 平方米）的宴会厅的建设继续进行，而法官们则考虑了旨在完全停止建造的诉讼。 在周一未签署的命令中，为施工扫清道路的五名法官表示，下级法院封锁舞厅的权力“可能超出了”。 虽然大多数人没有就东翼项目的合法性做出决定，但他们表示保护组织“缺乏资格”起诉政府。 他们裁定，特朗普政府已经证明，它很可能成功地辩称，如果不中止，它将“遭受不可挽回的伤害”。 首席大法官罗伯茨在异议中写道：“今天的决定并不是三权分立的胜利。” 针对这一裁决，特朗普发帖表示，他对“毫无根据”的诉讼未能停止建设感到“高兴”。 “我们生活在美国的黄金时代，这座建筑将成为华盛顿特区有史以来最伟大的建筑之一，”他说。 特朗普长期以来一直认为白宫需要更大的活动空间，最近又表示这对他的安全很重要。 共和党总统在四月份的白宫记者协会晚宴上涉嫌暗杀事件后强调了舞厅的必要性。 但国家历史保护信托基金认为，施工正在对历史地标造成不可逆转的损害。 该组织的立场源于保护主义者艾莉森·霍格兰（Alison Hoagland）的声明，她住在华盛顿特区，并在该信托基金的董事会任职。 霍格兰表示，她每个月都会到这个社区来一次，她声称，“如果建造一座拟议形式和规模的舞厅，她将遭受职业和个人伤害，包括我的审美、文化和历史兴趣”。 在...

reflection.en: This ruling on the White House ballroom project brings to mind the accountability of leaders. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." The debate over congressional approval and the legality of the construction underscores the importance of transparent governance...
reflection.zh: 关于白宫宴会厅项目的这项裁决，让人联想到领导者的问责制。耶利米书22:3呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被压迫者脱离欺压者的手”。关于国会批准和工程合法性的争议，凸显了透明治理和遵守既定程序的重要性，确保公共资金和项目在法律框架下服务于共同利益。

title.en: China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan's presence at Pacific leaders' summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋领导人峰会“将有后果”

summary.en: China's special envoy for Pacific Island Countries Affairs, Qian Bo, warned of "consequences" regarding Taiwan's participation as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, stating China has "serious concerns" and finds it "very inappropriate."
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波在帕劳举行的年度太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）领导人会议上，就台湾作为发展伙伴的与会一事发出“将有后果”的警告，并表示中国有“严重关切”，认为“非常不合适”。

body.en:
China's top Pacific Islands diplomat has warned "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, kicking off the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Qian Bo, Beijing's special envoy for Pacific Island Countries Affairs, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" with Taiwan's status as development partners at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the opening ceremony on Monday.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is this year being represented by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, Beijing placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taipei.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

Qian also claimed China has the "understanding and support" of the "majority" of PIF members and has made its position "very clear" to Palau.

This year's PIF has been mired in controversy ahead of its official start, with six leaders confirmed as no-shows, including outgoing forum chair and Solomon Islands Prime Minister Mathew Wale, as well as Kiribati's pro-Beijing president Taneti Maamau, who has pointedly sent his former ambassador to China, David Teabo, in his place instead.

Reasons for their absences range from national parliamentary duties and health, with Wale having arrived in Koror and forced to return home on the weekend to face a possible leadership challenge. But key leaders missing have cast doubt over whether there could be meaningful collective action on key agenda items at the three-day event, including on climate action...
body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: Diplomatic tensions often arise when nations have differing views on international participation. The envoy's strong words, while denied as a threat, signal a deep-seated concern that could escalate. In such moments, the call to pursue peace and seek understanding, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 当国家在国际参与问题上持有不同观点时，常常会引发外交紧张。特使的强硬言辞虽然否认是威胁，但却预示着一种可能升级的深层关切。在这样的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与理解的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Orangutans in danger as wildfires blaze through Borneo
title.zh: 婆罗洲野火肆虐，猩猩面临危险

summary.en: Wildfires in Indonesia have destroyed part of the natural habitat of hundreds of orangutans, risking the survival of the species. A weak orangutan was found lying on the ground in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, and will be moved to a rehabilitation center.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚的野火摧毁了数百只猩猩的部分自然栖息地，危及该物种的生存。在婆罗洲岛西加里曼丹省的卡塔庞，一只虚弱的猩猩被发现躺在地上，将被送往康复中心接受治疗。

body.en:
A weak orangutan was found laying on the ground in Ketapang, West Kalimantan on Borneo island.

Indonesia has intensified efforts to contain haze from wildfires across six provinces in Borneo and Sumatra islands.

The wildfires have destroyed part of the habitat of hundreds of orangutans and risking the survival of the species.

"The situation is quite critical", said Karmele Llano Sanchez, CEO of the wildlife foundation Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia (YIARI).

Sanchez said the fires are "leaving [the orangutans] without any food or water".

The orangutan found will be moved to a rehabilitation centre to get more treatment and will be released back into the wild after recovery, according to YIARI.
body.zh: 在婆罗洲岛西加里曼丹省的吉打邦，人们发现一只虚弱的猩猩躺在地上。 印度尼西亚加大了控制婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛六个省份野火雾霾的力度。 野火摧毁了数百只猩猩的部分栖息地，并危及该物种的生存。 “情况相当危急”，野生动物基金会 Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia (YIARI) 首席执行官 Karmele Llano Sanchez 表示。 桑切斯说，大火“让[猩猩]没有任何食物或水”。 据YIARI称，发现的猩猩将被转移到康复中心接受更多治疗，康复后将被放回野外。

reflection.en: The wildfires in Borneo have devastated the habitat of orangutans, leaving them vulnerable and without sustenance. This situation calls to mind the biblical mandate to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. We are reminded to advocate for the voiceless, especially when their very existence is threatened by human-caused environmental destruction.
reflection.zh: 婆罗洲的野火摧毁了猩猩的家园，使它们变得脆弱且缺乏食物。这一情况让人想起圣经中为那些不能为自己发声者代求的使命。我们被提醒要为无声者辩护，尤其是在它们的生存受到人类造成的环境破坏威胁之时。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Race to rescue hundreds trapped in tunnels as Nepal flood death toll tops 950
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水死亡人数超950人，救援人员争分夺秒营救隧道中数百人

summary.en: Rescuers are urgently working to free hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites in Nepal, which were buried by catastrophic flooding along the Nepal-China border. The combined death toll in Nepal and China has surpassed 950, with over 4400 people missing, including 43 Australians. A power company...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-中国边境，灾难性的洪水将水电站工地掩埋，救援人员正争分夺秒地营救据信被困在隧道中的数百名工人。尼泊尔和中国的合并死亡人数已超过950人，另有超过4400人失踪，其中包括43名澳大利亚人。一家电力公司协会报告称，在受损的12个水电项目中，至少有900名工人下落不明。

body.en:
Rescuers are racing to free hundreds of workers believed to be trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were buried in mud by catastrophic flooding on the Nepal-China border as the death toll climbs and increasingly desperate families searched for missing loved ones.

The combined deaths in Nepal and China surpassed 950, with more than 4400 people — including 43 Australians — missing.

A private-sector association representing power companies said at least 900 workers were unaccounted for at 12 hydropower projects damaged by the flash floods in Nepal's Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts.

At least one expert said that some workers could have access to oxygen, but others warned that the chances of finding survivors were diminishing.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As the rescue efforts intensified, four bodies were recovered from three mud-filled tunnels, Nepal's army said.

Some workers managed to call for help when the disaster struck last Wednesday, and others who managed to flee reported to authorities and relatives that many of their colleagues were still in the tunnels, said Mohan Kumar Dangi, president of the Independent Power Producers' Association.

It was unclear whether rescuers have had any contact with the trapped workers since the initial calls for help.

Six days after the disaster, fears were growing that some might have suffocated, Dangi said.

Rescue efforts were focused on people trapped in the gigantic tunnels built for controlling the flow of water.

"These tunnels are big enough to drive trucks through," said Jakob Steiner, a geoscientist at the University of Graz in Austria based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

"And from what we understand, they have managed to get oxygen to some of those stuck inside and are trying to rescue them now. It's a race for time, though, as people need food and water."

In the Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project, in the hard-hit Rasuwa district, at least 576 people were missing, Dangi said, adding that about 300 of them were believed to be trapped inside the project's tunnel.

At the Trishuli-3 Hydropower Project, crews were working to descend about 15 metres into a tunnel in an effort to reach those believed trapped inside, according to Nepali army spokesman Brigadier General Raja Ram Basnet.

Workers shovelling mud from a flood-ravaged power station in Dhading, Nepal, said the station is a key connection for providing power to more than 20,000 people in the region.

On the Chinese side, rescue and recovery efforts included rebuilding the road leading to the Gyirong Port border crossing that regulated travel between China and Nepal.

Trucks carried giant rocks as workers tried to repave a...
body.zh: 随着死亡人数不断攀升，以及越来越绝望的家庭寻找失踪亲人，救援人员正在竞相营救数百名据信被困在水电站隧道中的工人，这些工人因尼泊尔和中国边境的灾难性洪水而被埋在泥土中。 尼泊尔和中国的死亡人数合计超过 950 人，超过 4400 人失踪，其中包括 43 名澳大利亚人。 代表电力公司的私营部门协会表示，尼泊尔拉苏瓦和努瓦科特地区因山洪爆发而受损的 12 个水电项目中，至少有 900 名工人下落不明。 至少一位专家表示，一些工人可以获得氧气，但其他专家警告说，找到幸存者的机会正在减少。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尼泊尔军方表示，随着救援工作的加强，从三个充满泥浆的隧道中找到了四具尸体。 独立电力生产商协会主席莫汉·库马尔·丹吉(Mohan Kumar Dangi)表示，上周三灾难发生时，一些工人设法寻求帮助，其他设法逃离的工人向当局和亲属报告，他们的许多同事仍在隧道里。 目前还不清楚自最初发出求救信号以来，救援人员是否与被困工人有过任何接触。 丹吉说，灾难发生六天后，人们越来越担心有些人可能会窒息而死。 救援工作的重点是被困在为控制水流而建造的巨大隧道中的人们。 “这些隧道足够大，可以让卡车通过，”位于孟加拉国达卡的奥地利格拉茨大学的地球科学家雅各布·施泰纳说。 “据我们了解，他们已经设法为一些被困在里面的人提供氧气，并正在努力营救他们。不过，这是一场时间竞赛，因为人们需要食物和水。” Dangi 说，在受灾最严重的 Rasuwa 地区的 Upper Trishuli-1 水电站项目中，至少有 576 人失踪，并补充说，其中约 300 人据信被困在该项目的隧道内。 尼泊尔陆军发言人 Raja Ram Basnet 准将表示，在 Trishuli-3 水电项目中，工作人员正在努力下潜到隧道内约 15 米处，以营救被困在隧道内的人员。 尼泊尔达丁一座遭受洪水破坏的发电站的工人们正在铲泥，他们表示，该发电站是为该地区 2 万多人提供电力的关键线路。 中方的救援和恢复工作包括重建通往吉隆口岸的道路，该口岸负责控制中尼之间的交通。 当工人们试图重新铺设道路时，卡车运载着巨大的岩石。

reflection.en: The news from Nepal paints a grim picture of loss and desperation, with hundreds trapped and the death toll tragically high. In moments like these, when natural disaster brings such profound grief, we can turn to the promise that Yahweh will one day wipe away every tear. The hope of Revelation 21:4 offers solace, envisioning a future where suffering and...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔传来的消息描绘了一幅悲惨的失落和绝望的画面，数百人被困，死亡人数高得令人痛心。在这样的时刻，当自然灾害带来如此深切的悲痛时，我们可以转向雅伟的应许——祂终将擦去一切眼泪。启示录21:4的盼望提供了慰藉，它描绘了一个没有痛苦和死亡的未来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Two dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
title.zh: 大峡谷发生“可怕”的洪水，登山者失踪

summary.en: More than 20 people are thought to be unaccounted for after flash flooding on Saturday.
summary.zh: 周六，山洪暴发，据信有20多人失踪。

body.en:
Two people have died and 14 remain missing or unaccounted for after flash flooding swept through parts of the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service (NPS) has said.

The flood hit Bright Angel Canyon and the Phantom Ranch area on Saturday afternoon, wiping out footbridges and propelling boulders downstream.

The body of a 46-year-old man was found on Sunday evening near Crystal Rapids along the Colorado River, the park service said. Sixty-two people have so far been airlifted out of the area.

"The whole thing was terrifying," said Nikki Baggs, 41, who was among those to be airlifted out of the bottom of the Grand Canyon with her two friends.

"It was a beautiful day and then people were screaming, running," she told the BBC.

Baggs said she and her friends had just dropped off their belongings at a cabin in Phantom Ranch - a remote lodge at the bottom of the Grand Canyon - when they decided to venture out to enjoy the nice day. Before they knew it, a flood of water was sweeping through the area.

As soon as the rain hit, Baggs and her friends headed toward higher ground, where they sat at a picnic table, before rangers yelled to them to run again to a different ledge, where they waited with others for hours before they were evacuated at around 21:30 local time (04:30 GMT).

Baggs said she and her two friends had been looking forward to a steak dinner at Phantom Ranch - but were now just grateful to be alive thanks to a swift response from park rangers.

"It was a really uniquely co-ordinated effort," she said. "That's what made us feel safe about all of it in an unsafe situation."

Baggs said she and her friends watched from higher ground as bridges were swept away.

The recent rains in the Grand Canyon area, and more widely in south-western parts of the US, are due to monsoonal showers.

A change in wind direction at this time of year pulls warm, moist air northward from the Gulf of California and the tropical Pacific, triggering storms over mountainous terrain.

The storms are difficult to pinpoint in forecasts and so can strike without warning. But because the ground is usually very dry, any heavy downpours lead to dangerous flash flooding and frequent lightning which increases the threat of wildfires.

Flood watches from the National Weather Service cover large parts of Arizona, as well as New Mexico, Utah and Colorado. There are lots of showers currently showing on the weather radar and these downpours will continue during Monday.

The threat of flooding is something that will remain for many more weeks. The North American monsoon season usually runs to the end of September.

Joey Martin told the BBC that he was at the Grand Canyon working on a transcanyon pipeline project when dense, grey clouds rolled in.

He described rain "coming down so...
body.zh: 山洪席卷大峡谷部分地区后，据信有 20 多人失踪或下落不明。 据国家公园管理局 (NPS) 称，周六当地时间 14:30 左右（英国夏令时 22:30），袭击发生在光明天使峡谷和幻影牧场地区。 迄今为止，已有 62 人被空运出该地区，预计还会有更多人跟进。目前还没有人员受伤的报告。 “整件事太可怕了，”41 岁的尼基·巴格斯 (Nikki Baggs) 说，她是周六与她的两个朋友一起从大峡谷底部被空运出来的人之一。 “那是美好的一天，然后人们尖叫着、奔跑着，”她告诉英国广播公司。 巴格斯说，她和她的朋友们刚刚把行李放在幻影牧场（大峡谷底部的一个偏远小屋）的一间小屋里，然后决定出去享受美好的一天。在他们意识到之前，洪水席卷了整个地区。 雨一落下，巴格斯和她的朋友们就向地势较高的地方走去，她们坐在野餐桌旁，然后护林员向她们喊叫，让她们再次跑到另一个窗台上，她们和其他人在那里等了几个小时，然后在当地时间 21:30 左右被疏散。 巴格斯说，她和她的两个朋友一直期待着在幻影牧场吃牛排晚餐，但现在很庆幸自己还活着，多亏了公园管理员的迅速反应。 “这是一次真正独特的协调努力，”她说。 “这就是让我们在不安全的情况下感到安全的原因。” NPS 表示，洪水对一些地区造成了严重破坏，该地区的步道已关闭。巴格斯说，她和她的朋友们在地势较高的地方看着桥梁被冲走。 它要求任何认识周六在光明天使溪走廊沿线的内峡谷徒步旅行者或背包客的人与我们联系。 它还警告称，预计周日和周一将出现更多雷暴和强降雨，这可能导致“额外的山洪、泥石流、落石以及步道和河流状况的变化”。 大峡谷是美国最受欢迎的国家公园之一，每年约有 500 万人参观。光明天使步道是最受欢迎的徒步路线。

reflection.en: The Grand Canyon, a place of immense natural beauty, can also become a scene of terrifying power, as seen with the recent flash floods. In moments of overwhelming crisis, when the earth itself seems to tremble, we can find refuge and strength in Yahweh. He is our ever-present help in times of trouble, a steadfast anchor amidst the chaos.
reflection.zh: 大峡谷是一个自然美景极其壮丽的地方，但正如最近的洪水所示，它也可能变成一个充满可怕力量的场景。在压倒性的危机时刻，当地球本身似乎在颤抖时，我们可以在雅伟那里找到避难所和力量。祂是我们患难中随时的帮助，是混乱中的坚定锚。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard' after first exchange of fire in weeks
title.zh: 特朗普誓言在数周来首次交火后严厉打击伊朗

summary.en: The US and Iran are at a tense diplomatic stalemate, with President Trump vowing to respond forcefully after an exchange of fire, which included US strikes on an Iranian island and Iranian retaliation against US military targets.
summary.zh: 尽管敌对行动升级，美国和伊朗仍处于紧张的外交僵局中。美国总统特朗普誓言将做出强硬回应，此前双方进行了数周来的首次交火，包括美军袭击伊朗一岛屿，伊朗随后报复袭击了中东的美军目标。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump threatened on Tuesday to hit Iran "hard" after the two foes traded fire for the first time in weeks, as his Treasury secretary vowed to keep up a pressure campaign aimed at hobbling Iran's economy.

After six months of war, the foes remain at an impasse, with Iran keeping the strategic Strait of Hormuz closed and the US persisting with a naval counter-blockade of Iranian ports.

On Monday, the US carried out strikes on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran quickly retaliating by attacking US military targets in the Middle East.

The exchange raised fears of a return to major hostilities, with the US president vowing to respond.

"We're going to hit them hard," Trump said, according to a Fox News reporter who spoke to him briefly. "There will be a response."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The United States said it attacked Iranian rocket launchers on the island of Larak to prevent Iran planting mines in the key shipping lane.

Iran responded with missile and drone attacks aimed at Jordan and the United Arab Emirates, saying they targeted US forces there, but President Masoud Pezeshkian later on Tuesday called for dialogue.

"We continue to strive for a path of agreement and understanding, and we believe that continuing the war is neither in our interest, nor in the interest of the region," he said at a summit in Kyrgyzstan, adding "the solution to the existing problems is dialogue and cooperation".

State media reported that three people were killed in the US attack on Larak, with several others wounded.

Iran's powerful Revolutionary Guards said the ballistic missile attack targeting two US air bases in Jordan caused "heavy damage".

But Trump told Fox that all the missiles fired at US forces had been shot down, except for one that was determined not to pose a threat. Jordan's army said it had intercepted eight missiles, without stating their origin.

Iran also said it targeted US personnel at an air base in the UAE, and shot down an American drone over Hormuz.

Abu Dhabi said it intercepted a drone over the country's waters, but dismissed claims that Al Minhad Air Base had been targeted as "baseless".

The Guards reported knocking out a second US drone over the Hormuz on Monday evening, and Iran's armed forces central command reiterated a warning to its regional neighbours not to allow the US to use their territory to carry out attacks.

The exchange of fire came after weeks of relative calm, with the Trump administration recently pivoting to "economic warfare".

Earlier on Monday, Trump had called Iran "a Failed Nation", saying on social media that its military was decimated, its finances were...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二在这两个敌人几周来首次交火后威胁要“严厉”打击伊朗，他的财政部长发誓要继续施压，旨在阻碍伊朗经济。 经过六个月的战争，敌人仍处于僵局，伊朗关闭了战略性的霍尔木兹海峡，而美国则坚持对伊朗港口进行海上反封锁。 周一，美国对霍尔木兹海峡的伊朗岛屿发动袭击，伊朗迅速报复，袭击了美国在中东的军事目标。 这次交锋引发了人们对重新爆发重大敌对行动的担忧，美国总统誓言要做出回应。 据一位与特朗普简短交谈过的福克斯新闻记者称，“我们将严厉打击他们”。 “会有回应的。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 美国表示，袭击了拉拉克岛上的伊朗火箭发射器，以阻止伊朗在关键航道上埋设地雷。 伊朗以针对约旦和阿拉伯联合酋长国的导弹和无人机袭击作为回应，称他们的目标是那里的美军，但总统马苏德·佩泽什基安周二晚些时候呼吁进行对话。 他在吉尔吉斯斯坦举行的峰会上表示：“我们继续努力寻求协议和理解的道路，我们认为继续战争既不符合我们的利益，也不符合该地区的利益。”他补充说，“解决现有问题的办法是对话与合作”。 官方媒体报道称，美国对拉拉克的袭击造成三人死亡，多人受伤。 伊朗强大的革命卫队表示，针对约旦两个美国空军基地的弹道导弹袭击造成了“严重损失”。 但特朗普告诉福克斯新闻，除了一枚确定不构成威胁的导弹外，所有向美军发射的导弹都已被击落。约旦军方表示已拦截八枚导弹，但未说明其来源。 伊朗还表示，它以阿联酋空军基地的美国人员为目标，并在霍尔木兹上空击落了一架美国无人机。 阿布扎比表示，它在该国水域拦截了一架无人机，但否认了明哈德空军基地成为袭击目标的说法，称其“毫无根据”。 伊朗卫队报告称，周一晚间击落了霍尔木兹海峡上空的第二架美国无人机，伊朗武装部队中央司令部再次警告其地区邻国，不要允许美国利用其领土发动袭击。 此次交火是在经历了几周相对平静之后发生的，特朗普政府最近转向“经济战”。 周一早些时候，特朗普称伊朗是“一个失败的国家”，并在社交媒体上表示，其军队遭到重创，其财政状况......

reflection.en: The news of escalating hostilities between the US and Iran, marked by an exchange of fire, presents a stark reminder of the destructive cycle of retaliation. The temptation to meet force with greater force is strong, yet Scripture calls us to a higher path. May we pray for leaders to choose the difficult way of overcoming evil with good, breaking the chains...
reflection.zh: 美伊两国之间敌对行动升级的消息，以双方交火为标志，严峻地提醒人们报复的毁灭性循环。以更大的武力回应的诱惑很强烈，但圣经呼唤我们走上一条更高的道路。愿我们为领导人祈祷，让他们选择以善胜恶的艰难道路，为了和平打破报复的枷锁。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: 'It hurts': Lionel Messi announces international retirement after World Cup final defeat
title.zh: “很受伤”：莱昂内尔·梅西在世界杯决赛失利后宣布退出国家队

summary.en: The curtain falls on one of football's most storied international careers.
summary.zh: 足球界最传奇的国际职业生涯之一落下帷幕。

body.en:
Lionel Messi said on Tuesday he was retiring from international football after leading Argentina to a second successive World Cup final in July.

The 39-year-old forward, who won the World Cup in 2022 and dragged his nation to the final in the United States only to lose to Spain, said the decision had been painful.

"It was a decision that hurt and still hurts deep in my soul but I understand that it is the right time," Messi wrote on Instagram.

"I swear I always gave everything, not just in the last few years when we won everything but before that too, and I always fought and gave my all for this shirt," he added.

Messi led Argentina to World Cup glory four years ago by winning the final against France in a penalty shootout in Doha, but his side lost 1-0 to a superior Spain side in the 2026 final in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Following the death of his father Jorge in August, Messi had said he had "serious doubts" about continuing to play football of any sort for "much longer".

"I don't know what I'll do without you, I don't know how to go on. I just played football, and now I have serious doubts about continuing to do so for much longer," he said then.

Messi's contract with Major League Soccer club Inter Miami runs until the end of the 2028 season.

In this year's finals, Messi inspired Argentina to another final by scoring eight goals and provided two assists in the dramatic late comeback against England in the semi-finals.

But the dream of lifting the trophy again proved one match too far as the South Americans lost to Spain at MetLife Stadium (dubbed New York New Jersey Stadium for the duration of the World Cup).

Messi was pictured in tears after receiving his loser's medal. He said afterwards that the pain of defeat was "immense" and that it would "take a long time for this wound to heal".

In his statement on Tuesday, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner said it was time for a new generation of Argentina players to take up the torch.

"I love, I loved, and I will always love being on the national team," he wrote. "I gave everything I had, I have nothing more to give, and besides, there are some very talented young players coming up behind me who deserve to be there."

Reacting to the news, FIFA president Gianni Infantino called Messi "one of the greatest players our sport has ever seen" and thanked him for "bringing so much joy to millions of football fans".

First called up in 2005 by Jose Nestor Pekerman as an 18-year-old, Messi would go on to play 207 times for Argentina and become the country's leading scorer, with 125 goals.

Messi also won two Copa Americas in 2021 and 2024 during his 21-year...
body.zh: 莱昂内尔·梅西(Lionel Messi)周二表示，在7月带领阿根廷队连续第二次闯入世界杯决赛后，他将退出国家队。 这位39岁的前锋在2022年赢得了世界杯，并带领他的国家队进入了在美国举行的决赛，结果输给了西班牙，他表示这个决定是痛苦的。 梅西在Instagram上写道：“这个决定深深地伤害了我的灵魂，但我知道现在是时候了。” “我发誓我总是付出一切，不仅是在过去几年我们赢得了一切，而且在那之前也是如此，我总是为这件球衣而奋斗并付出我的一切，”他补充道。 四年前，梅西带领阿根廷队在多哈的决赛中通过点球大战击败法国队赢得了世界杯冠军，但他的球队在2026年新泽西州东卢瑟福举行的决赛中以1-0输给了实力更强的西班牙队。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在他的父亲豪尔赫八月份去世后，梅西曾表示，他对继续踢任何类型的足球“更长时间”感到“严重怀疑”。 “我不知道没有你我会做什么，我不知道如何继续下去。我只是踢足球，现在我严重怀疑是否要继续踢更长时间，”他当时说道。 梅西与美国职业足球大联盟俱乐部迈阿密国际队的合同将持续到 2028 年赛季结束。 在今年的决赛中，梅西在半决赛对阵英格兰的比赛中打进8球并贡献两次助攻，带领阿根廷队再次闯入决赛。 但事实证明，再次捧起奖杯的梦想在一场比赛中太过遥远，南美队在大都会人寿体育场（世界杯期间被称为纽约新泽西体育场）输给了西班牙队。 梅西在获得失败者奖牌后流下了眼泪。他事后表示，失败的痛苦是“巨大的”，并且“这个伤口需要很长时间才能愈合”。 这位八次金球奖得主在周二的声明中表示，现在是新一代阿根廷球员接过火炬的时候了。 他写道：“我爱，我爱，我将永远喜欢成为国家队的一员。” “我付出了我所拥有的一切，我没有什么可以给予的，此外，我身后有一些非常有才华的年轻球员，他们值得在那里。” 国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺对此消息作出反应，称梅西是“我们这项运动有史以来最伟大的球员之一”，并感谢他“给数百万球迷带来了如此多的欢乐”。 2005 年，18 岁的梅西首次被何塞·内斯特·佩克尔曼征召，随后为阿根廷队出场 207 次，并以 125 个进球成为该国的头号射手。 梅西在21年的职业生涯中还赢得了2021年和2024年两届美洲杯冠军...

reflection.en: Lionel Messi, after a career spanning decades and marked by incredible achievements, has announced his retirement from international football. He described the decision as one that "hurts deep in my soul," reflecting the emotional weight of concluding such a significant chapter. His words, "I swear I always gave everything," speak to the dedication and...
reflection.zh: 莱昂内尔·梅西在长达数十年的职业生涯中取得了辉煌的成就，现已宣布退出国家队。他形容这个决定“深深刺痛我的灵魂”，这反映了结束如此重要篇章的情感重负。他说：“我发誓我总是付出了全部”，这体现了他为代表国家所付出的奉献和努力，这是一场充满激情和承诺的奔跑。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: Across Latin America, 'aura battles' burst onto the scene
title.zh: 拉丁美洲各地，“气场对决”崭露头角

summary.en: Young people across Latin America are participating in contests where they compete to demonstrate the greatest charisma. Through poses, dance moves, gestures, and eye-catching outfits, contestants vie for the audience's approval.
summary.zh: 拉丁美洲的年轻人正在参加各种比赛，争夺最强的个人魅力。参赛者通过姿势、舞步、手势和引人注目的服装来争取观众的认可。

body.en: Young people across Latin America are taking part in viral “aura battles”, where contestants compete to prove who has the most charisma. Using poses, dance moves, gestures and eye-catching outfits, participants battle for the crowd’s approval.
body.zh: 拉丁美洲各地的年轻人正在参加病毒式的“光环之战”，参赛者竞相证明谁最具魅力。参与者通过姿势、舞蹈动作、手势和引人注目的服装，争取观众的认可。

reflection.en: In these 'aura battles,' the pursuit of charisma and crowd approval takes center stage. Philippians 2:3 calls us to look beyond ourselves, urging us to consider others as more important than ourselves and to act with humility. This ancient wisdom challenges the modern drive for self-promotion, reminding us that true worth is found not in seeking personal...
reflection.zh: 在这些“气场对决”中，对个人魅力和观众认可的追求成为了焦点。腓立比书2章3节呼吁我们超越自我，看别人比自己强，并以谦卑的心行事。这古老的智慧挑战了现代社会推崇自我宣传的趋势，提醒我们真正的价值并非在于追求个人荣耀，而在于无私的服务和对他人的尊重。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Festival honouring Dolly Parton set for Nashville and London
title.zh: 纪念桃莉·帕顿的音乐节将在纳什维尔和伦敦举行

summary.en: Dolly Parton's estate has announced DollyFest, a two-day festival planned for London and Nashville in 2027, to celebrate her life and legacy. This event is intended to be the 'party of a lifetime' that Parton herself envisioned, taking the place of a public memorial.
summary.zh: 桃莉·帕顿的遗产管理方宣布，将于2027年在伦敦和纳什维尔举办为期两天的DollyFest音乐节，以庆祝她的生平和遗产。该活动旨在成为帕顿本人设想的“一生中最盛大的派对”，并取代传统的公开纪念仪式。

body.en:
Dolly Parton's estate has announced a festival honouring the life and legacy of the late singer, set for London and Nashville.

The "star-studded" two-day DollyFest will happen across two consecutive weekends in both cities in 2027, her estate said in a Monday press release, adding that the specific dates will be announced later.

Parton herself dreamed up an earlier version of the event, where she would host and perform alongside other artists, but the original January 2026 event was called off before it was announced publicly, due to Parton's health struggles, her estate said.

"DOLLYFEST will be the party of a lifetime she wanted to share with the world," her estate said.

DollyFest will take the place of a traditional public memorial for the artist, who died at the age of 80 on 25 August after a brief battle with cancer.

She was laid to rest at a private family funeral in Nashville on Friday, and placed next to her late husband, Carl Dean, at Woodlawn Memorial Park and Mausoleum in the Tennessee city, her great-niece said.

DollyFest organiser Danny Nozell, the founder and CEO of CTK Enterprises, said the estate is not discouraging people from celebrating Dolly in whatever ways they choose, but Parton did not want a traditional memorial.

"It feels more appropriate for us to take a beat, let all the tributes that immediately make sense occur naturally, and then, see through this festival-style concept that was truly dreamed up by Dolly," Nozell said.

"This is something that is authentic to her, something that feels right to me, and something that artists and fans around the world can participate in, while also giving everyone time to grieve, and giving everyone time to plan."

Originally from the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee, Parton was a country music icon , philanthropist and businesswoman whose most famous songs included Coat of Many Colors, Jolene and I Will Always Love You.

In a seven-decade career, Parton won 10 Grammy awards, sold more than 100 million records worldwide, and wrote thousands of songs.

Parton took her writing seriously, and considered herself a songwriter over everything else. "It's my way of expressing myself," she said. "It's my therapy."

Since her death, emotional tributes from celebrities, politicians, and countless fans have flooded social media.

"A lot of people always say, WWDD (What Would Dolly Do?), and, well, at this moment, DOLLYFEST is WDWD (What Dolly Would Do!)," Nozell said.
body.zh: 多莉·帕顿的遗产管理机构宣布在伦敦和纳什维尔举办一个节日，纪念这位已故歌手的一生和遗产。 她的庄园在周一的新闻稿中表示，为期两天的“众星云集”的 DollyFest 活动将于 2027 年在这两个城市连续两个周末举行，并补充说具体日期将在稍后公布。 帕顿本人梦想了该活动的早期版本，她将在那里与其他艺术家一起主持和表演，但她的遗产委员会表示，由于帕顿的健康问题，原定于 2026 年 1 月举行的活动在公开宣布之前就被取消了。 她的遗产管理机构表示：“DOLLYFEST 将成为她一生难忘的聚会，她想与世界分享。” DollyFest 将取代这位艺术家的传统公共纪念活动，这位艺术家在与癌症进行了短暂的斗争后于 8 月 25 日去世，享年 80 岁。 她的侄孙女说，周五，她被安葬在纳什维尔的一个私人家庭葬礼上，并被安葬在田纳西州伍德劳恩纪念公园和陵墓的已故丈夫卡尔·迪恩旁边。 多莉节的组织者、CTK Enterprises 的创始人兼首席执行官丹尼·诺泽尔 (Danny Nozell) 表示，庄园并不阻止人们以任何方式庆祝多莉，但帕顿并不想要传统的纪念馆。 诺泽尔说：“我们感觉更合适的是先缓一缓，让所有立即有意义的致敬自然发生，然后看透这个真正由多莉梦想的节日式概念。” “这对她来说是真实的，对我来说是正确的，也是世界各地的艺术家和粉丝可以参与的事情，同时也让每个人都有时间悲伤，并让每个人有时间进行计划。” 帕顿来自田纳西州的大烟山，是一位乡村音乐偶像、慈善家和女商人，她最著名的歌曲包括《Coat of Many Colors》、《Jolene》和《I Will Always Love You》。 在七十年的职业生涯中，帕顿赢得了 10 项格莱美奖，在全球售出了超过 1 亿张唱片，并创作了数千首歌曲。 帕顿认真对待她的写作，并认为自己是一名高于一切的词曲作者。 “这是我表达自己的方式，”她说。 “这是我的疗法。” 自她去世以来，社交媒体上充斥着名人、政客和无数粉丝的情感悼念。 “很多人总是说，WWDD（多莉会做什么？），而此时此刻，DOLLYFEST 就是 WDWD（多莉会做什么！），”诺泽尔说。

reflection.en: The announcement of DollyFest honors the vibrant life and enduring legacy of Dolly Parton. It reflects a desire to celebrate a life fully lived, a 'race finished' with joy and impact, as the Apostle Paul described his own journey. This festival offers a way to remember and rejoice in the gifts she shared with the world.
reflection.zh: DollyFest音乐节的宣布，是对桃莉·帕顿充满活力的生命和持久遗产的致敬。这体现了一种庆祝充实人生的愿望，正如使徒保罗所描述的，这是一场“跑完了当跑的路”，并留下了深远的影响。这个音乐节提供了一种方式来纪念和欢庆她与世界分享的恩赐。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水图像

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后发生了数字镇压。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则向平台充斥官方内容。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The swift erasure of flood images in Tibet, replacing them with official narratives, speaks to the power of information control. As Ephesians 4:25 reminds us, 'Therefore, each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor, for we are all members of one body.' The deliberate suppression of reality, even in the face of natural disaster,...
reflection.zh: 在西藏，洪水图像被迅速抹去，并被官方叙事所取代，这凸显了信息控制的力量。正如以弗所书4:25所提醒我们的：“所以，你们各人要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说诚实话，因为我们是互相联络的一体。” 故意压制现实，即使在面对自然灾害时，也会阻碍社区的治愈和相互理解。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Deceived and deployed: How young Cameroonians end up fighting in Russia's war in Ukraine
title.zh: 被欺骗和部署：喀麦隆青年如何卷入俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争

summary.en: Economic hardship and deceptive recruitment practices are drawing young Cameroonians into the Russian military, leading to severe consequences. The article questions the Cameroonian government's response to this crisis.
summary.zh: 经济困境和欺骗性的征兵行为正将喀麦隆青年卷入俄罗斯军队，并导致严重后果。文章质疑喀麦隆政府对此危机的应对。

body.en:
Analysts say economic desperation and fraudulent recruitment schemes are funneling Cameroonian youth into the Russian military — with deadly consequences.

Cameroon has emerged as one of the  leading sources of African recruits for the Russian military , with young men lured to Europe by false promises of jobs and fast-tracked Russian citizenship, only to find themselves on the front lines of the war in Ukraine.

As of May this year, Ukrainian officials say that nearly 3,000 citizens from various African countries were known to have fought — or to still be fighting — for Russia  : Cameroon, Ghana, Egypt, Kenya and Uganda were identified as significant.

In April, the Cameroonian government confirmed that Russia had reported the deaths of 16 Cameroonian nationals, seven of whom had died in military action in Ukraine.

The actual death toll is likely higher according to DW correspondent Dorcas Ekupe, reporting from Bamenda in northwestern Cameroon.

"When you look at other publications and see what is happening — even seeing families who are grieving their loved ones — the number is really much higher than what the government had earlier said," Ekupe told DW's AfricaLink program.

She described two forces causing this worrying phenomenon: economic desperation and deliberate deception.

Many recruits, she said, travelled to Russia believing they had secured jobs in construction or as security guards, or that they were participating in study programs.

Russia's perceived appeal meanwhile is also being amplified by well-organized campaigns.

Banjo Herman, a lecturer and political analyst at the University of Bamenda, pointed to the key role of the the Russian paramilitary Wagner Group as well as its successor, the Africa Corps, as Moscow's primary instrument for expanding its presence and reputation across Africa.

Herman also cited Russian government programs such as the African Initiative and Alabuga, which present themselves as cultural or educational exchange schemes but have been linked to military recruitment.

"On the surface, sometimes it looks like cultural outreach," he said. "Sometimes Cameroonians are lured, thinking it is for work, not necessarily knowing what is beneath the surfac.," He added that offers of Russian nationality within six months were a particularly powerful draw.

France has previously described the African Initiative as a front administered by Russian intelligence services, designed to spread propaganda.

Herman stressed, however, that the  economic situation of the men was typically the main motivator .

"Imagine that you are a carpenter in Cameroon who cannot even earn 100,000 CFA  francs (€150; $175) a month, but somebody is promising you 3...
body.zh: 分析人士表示，经济绝望和欺诈性招募计划正在将喀麦隆年轻人输送到俄罗斯军队，并带来致命的后果。喀麦隆政府是否需要采取更加果断的行动？ 喀麦隆已成为俄罗斯军队非洲新兵的主要来源之一，年轻人被虚假的就业承诺和快速获得俄罗斯公民身份的诱惑所吸引，却发现自己身处乌克兰战争的前线。 乌克兰官员表示，截至今年 5 月，已知有近 3,000 名来自非洲各国的公民曾经或仍在为俄罗斯而战；喀麦隆、加纳、埃及、肯尼亚和乌干达被确定为主要来源国。 4月，喀麦隆政府证实俄罗斯已报告16名喀麦隆国民死亡，其中7人在乌克兰的军事行动中丧生。 德国之声通讯员多卡斯·埃库佩 (Dorcas Ekupe) 在喀麦隆西北部巴门达报道称，实际死亡人数可能更高。 埃库佩告诉德国之声非洲联播节目：“当你看其他出版物，看看正在发生的事情，甚至看到那些正在哀悼亲人的家庭时，这个数字确实比政府早些时候所说的要高得多。” 她描述了造成这种令人担忧的现象的两种力量：经济绝望和故意欺骗。 她说，许多新兵前往俄罗斯时相信自己已经找到了建筑业或保安的工作，或者正在参加学习项目。 巴门达大学讲师兼政治分析家班乔·赫尔曼指出，俄罗斯准军事瓦格纳集团及其继任者非洲军团发挥着关键作用，是莫斯科在非洲扩大其影响力和声誉的主要工具。 他还引用了俄罗斯政府的“非洲倡议”和“阿拉布加”等计划，这些计划自称是文化或教育交流计划，但与征兵有关。 “从表面上看，有时这看起来像是文化外展，”班卓说。 “有时喀麦隆人会被吸引，认为这是为了工作，不一定知道表面之下是什么，”他补充说，六个月内获得俄罗斯国籍也是一个特别强大的吸引力。 法国此前曾将非洲倡议描述为俄罗斯情报部门管理的一个阵线，旨在传播宣传。 然而，班卓强调，新兵的经济状况通常是主要动机。 “想象一下，您是喀麦隆的一名木匠，每月甚至无法赚取 10 万非洲法郎（150 欧元；175 美元），但有人承诺给您 300 万非洲法郎来工作，”他解释道。 “这是...

reflection.en: Young Cameroonians, driven by economic desperation, are being ensnared by fraudulent recruitment schemes, leading them to the front lines of a brutal war. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot defend themselves and to ensure justice for the poor and the vulnerable, a principle desperately needed in this situation.
reflection.zh: 出于经济绝望的喀麦隆青年，正落入欺诈性征兵计划的陷阱，将他们带到残酷战争的前线。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为那些无法自卫的人发声，并为穷人和弱势群体伸张正义，这一原则在此情境下尤为迫切需要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Tariffs spat: Carney bets Canada can defy Trump
title.zh: 关税之争：卡尼押注加拿大能抵制特朗普

summary.en: Canada faces new US import penalties after Prime Minister Mark Carney refused to match US tariffs on China. Other countries are watching as the Trump trade clash turns into a fight over economic sovereignty.
summary.zh: 在总理马克·卡尼拒绝匹配中国对美关税后，加拿大正面临新的美国进口处罚。其他国家正密切关注这场特朗普贸易冲突如何演变成一场争夺经济主权的斗争。

body.en:
Canada is facing new US import penalties after Prime Minister Mark Carney refused to match US tariffs on China. Other countries are watching as the Trump trade clash turns into a fight over economic sovereignty.

Canada has been quietly praised for refusing to fold under pressure from US President Donald Trump in the long-running fight over trade tariffs .

The latest talks between the North American neighbors collapsed on August 21. Until the 11th hour, both sides were talking as if a deal was within reach.

The United States then put 50% tariffs on about $20 billion (€17.2 billion) worth of Canadian goods, while Ottawa pledged to match those duties on US imports.

Until the talks folded, Canada's approach was to cut a deal that would reduce the tariffs and keep cross-border supply chains functioning, particularly in the automotive  and steel sectors.

US negotiators were, however, accused of changing the terms at the last minute, which the Canadian side said would have forced them to match US tariffs on China .

According to Ottawa, Washington wanted a say on future trade deals with other nations and to prevent Chinese goods being routed through Canada to evade US duties.

Dan Ciuriak, a senior fellow at the Waterloo, Canada-based Center for International Governance Innovation, described Trump's tariff-matching plan as "fortress North America," which he said was now a sovereignty issue for Ottawa.

"Canada is a trading nation," Ciuriak told DW. "If we align perfectly with the Americans — primarily about China — we then end up sacrificing our trade policy."

There is a recent precedent. When the US imposed 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles last year, Canada followed suit. Beijing retaliated with 100% tariffs against one of Canada's biggest exports — canola.

Canada's $4.9 billion exports of canola oil, meal and seed to China were cut in half last year, according to data from the Canada China Business Council.

"The smaller country is the one that bears the brunt in this kind of game. So that's one very good reason for Canada to have an independent trade policy," said Ciuriak.

As the US-Canada talks collapsed, Ottawa also complained that Washington had sought relief from rules on French-language movies and shows. Canada said this amounted to interference in its language and culture.

Despite the uncertainty and higher cost to business from walking away, the Canadian prime minister's approach to negotiations with the US has broad public support.

A survey conducted by the Angus Reid Institute found that three-in-four Canadians backed the more hard-line move, despite concerns over the impact on the domestic...
body.zh: 在加拿大总理马克·卡尼拒绝追随美国对中国征收的关税后，加拿大面临美国新的进口处罚。其他国家正在关注特朗普的贸易冲突演变成一场经济主权之争。 加拿大因在长期的贸易关税斗争中拒绝在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的压力下屈服而受到悄悄赞扬。 这两个北美邻国之间的最新谈判于 8 月 21 日破裂。直到 11 小时，双方都在谈论仿佛达成协议已触手可及。 随后，美国对价值约 200 亿美元（172 亿欧元）的加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税，而渥太华则承诺对美国进口商品征收同样的关税。 在谈判破裂之前，加拿大的做法是达成一项降低关税并保持跨境供应链正常运转的协议，特别是在汽车和钢铁行业。 然而，美国谈判代表被指控在最后一刻改变条款，加拿大方面表示，这将迫使他们与美国对中国征收的关税相匹配。 据渥太华称，华盛顿希望对未来与其他国家的贸易协议拥有发言权，并防止中国商品通过加拿大转运以逃避美国关税。 加拿大滑铁卢国际治理创新中心高级研究员丹·丘里亚克 (Dan Ciuriak) 将特朗普的关税匹配计划描述为“北美堡垒”，他表示这现在是渥太华的主权问题。 “加拿大是一个贸易国家，”Ciuriak 告诉德国之声。 “如果我们与美国人完全一致——主要是在中国问题上——那么我们最终会牺牲我们的贸易政策。” 最近就有先例。去年，当美国对中国电动汽车征收 100% 关税时，加拿大也紧随其后。 北京方面对加拿大最大的出口产品之一——油菜籽征收 100% 的关税进行报复。 加中贸易理事会的数据显示，去年加拿大对中国的芥花籽油、菜粕和种子出口额减少了一半，价值 49 亿美元。 “在这种游戏中，较小的国家首当其冲。因此，这是加拿大实行独立贸易政策的一个很好的理由，”Ciuriak 说。 随着美加谈判破裂，渥太华还抱怨华盛顿寻求放松对法语电影和节目的规定。加拿大表示，这相当于对其语言和文化的干扰。 尽管存在不确定性并且退出会给企业带来更高的成本，但加拿大总理与美国谈判的方法得到了广泛的公众支持。 安格斯·里德研究所进行的一项调查发现，四分之三的加拿大人支持这一更为强硬的举措，尽管担心这对国内经济的影响......

reflection.en: In the face of escalating trade disputes, Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney has chosen not to mirror the US tariffs. This decision, while potentially costly, reflects a commitment to de-escalation rather than further retaliation. The situation highlights the delicate balance leaders must strike between national interest and the pursuit of peaceful...
reflection.zh: 面对不断升级的贸易争端，加拿大总理马克·卡尼选择不效仿美国的关税措施。这一决定虽然可能付出代价，但体现了致力于缓和局势而非进一步报复的承诺。这一局面凸显了领导人在国家利益与追求和平经济关系之间必须谨慎权衡的难题。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Putin-Modi meeting at SCO: Can Russia-India ties hold?
title.zh: 普京-莫迪在上海合作组织会晤：俄印关系能否维系？

summary.en: Indian Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are attending the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan amidst growing tensions with Washington for both Moscow and New Delhi.
summary.zh: 印度总理莫迪和俄罗斯总统普京正在吉尔吉斯斯坦举行的上海合作组织（SCO）峰会上会晤，此时莫斯科和新德里都面临着与华盛顿日益紧张的关系。

body.en:
Indian Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan as Moscow and New Delhi face rising tensions with Washington.

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi  and Russian President Vladimir Putin  are set to meet in Kyrgyzstan's capital, Bishkek, on Monday on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) summit — a bloc often seen as a counterweight to US influence.

The meeting comes against the backdrop of the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran , which has disrupted global energy markets, and Russia's war in Ukraine , now in its fifth year.

India has remained engaged with the SCO while resisting efforts to turn it into an anti-Western bloc. Its position reflects a broader effort to maintain relationships with competing powers.

That approach is under greater pressure. Russia  remains under Western sanctions over the war in Ukraine. Meanwhile, India has faced US pressure over its purchases of Russian oil, alongside wider trade tensions.

A former Indian ambassador to the US, Meera Shankar, told DW that India's relationship with Russia should not be seen as directed against the US.

"India has a long-standing strategic relationship with Russia. This is not directed against any country but intended to help India meet its national goals," said Shankar. 

Energy has become the most visible change in the India-Russia relationship . 

Before 2022, when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, it supplied only a small share of India's crude imports. Discounted Russian oil rapidly changed that, making Moscow one of India's biggest suppliers.

It has also become the most contentious part of India's relationship with the US, which has pressed New Delhi to reduce its purchases from Russia . India maintains that securing affordable and reliable energy is a national interest.

The disruption to traditional energy supplies has made that calculation more complicated. This year's US-Israel war on Iran and disruption of traffic through the Strait of Hormuz have affected India's purchases from the Gulf and pushed up prices.

Shankar said India is responding by diversifying its sources of supply, including both Russia and the US.

"In the long run, a transition to a non-fossil fuel economy would strengthen India's energy independence. But this will not happen overnight," she added.

Until then, Shankar said, India will take steps it considers necessary to stabilize supplies and protect its people. 

Defense remains the other major pillar, but here the direction of travel is clearer: India's dependence on Russian equipment has been declining.

The Ukraine war has raised questions over Russia's production capacity, delivery...
body.zh: 印度总理莫迪和俄罗斯总统普京出席在吉尔吉斯斯坦举行的上海合作组织（SCO）峰会，莫斯科和新德里与华盛顿的紧张关系日益加剧。 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于周一在上海合作组织 (SCO) 峰会期间在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克会面，该组织通常被视为抗衡美国影响力的组织。 此次会议召开的背景是美以对伊朗的战争扰乱了全球能源市场，而俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争现已进入第五个年头。 印度一直与上合组织保持接触，同时抵制将其变成反西方集团的努力。它的立场反映了维持与竞争大国关系的更广泛努力。 这种做法面临着更大的压力。俄罗斯仍因乌克兰战争而受到西方制裁。与此同时，印度因购买俄罗斯石油而面临美国的压力，而且贸易紧张局势更广泛。 印度前驻美大使梅拉·香卡 (Meera Shankar) 向德国之声表示，印度与俄罗斯的关系不应被视为针对美国。 香卡表示：“印度与俄罗斯有着长期的战略关系。这不是针对任何国家，而是为了帮助印度实现其国家目标。” 能源成为印俄关系中最明显的变化。 在2022年俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵之前，它只供应了印度原油进口的一小部分。俄罗斯石油打折迅速改变了这一状况，使莫斯科成为印度最大的供应国之一。 这也成为印度与美国关系中最具争议的部分，迫使新德里减少从俄罗斯的采购。 印度认为，获得负担得起且可靠的能源符合国家利益。 传统能源供应的中断使计算变得更加复杂。今年的美以对伊朗的战争以及霍尔木兹海峡的交通中断影响了印度从海湾地区的采购并推高了价格。 尚卡表示，印度的应对措施是实现供应来源多元化，其中包括俄罗斯和美国。 “从长远来看，向非化石燃料经济转型将加强印度的能源独立性。但这不会在一夜之间发生，”她补充道。 尚卡表示，在此之前，印度将采取其认为必要的措施来稳定供应并保护其人民。 国防仍然是另一个主要支柱，但这里的发展方向更加明确：印度对俄罗斯装备的依赖一直在下降。 乌克兰战争引发了对俄罗斯生产能力、交付能力的质疑……

reflection.en: As leaders gather at the SCO summit, the complexities of international relations are on full display. The meeting between Prime Minister Modi and President Putin occurs against a backdrop of geopolitical shifts, where maintaining diplomatic ties requires careful navigation. The call to 'live peaceably with all' reminds us to seek understanding and...

title.en: China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan's presence at Pacific leaders' summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋岛国论坛将带来“后果”

summary.en: China's top diplomat for Pacific Island Countries, Qian Bo, has warned of 'consequences' regarding Taiwan's presence as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau. He expressed China's 'serious concerns' and called Taiwan's participation 'inappropriate,' though he denied...
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波警告，台湾作为太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议的发展伙伴出席将带来“后果”。他表达了中国“严重关切”，并称台湾的参与“不恰当”，但他否认其言论是威胁。

body.en:
China's top Pacific Islands diplomat has warned "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, kicking off the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Qian Bo, Beijing's special envoy for Pacific Island Countries Affairs, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" with Taiwan's status as development partners at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the opening ceremony on Monday.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is this year being represented by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, Beijing placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taipei.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

Qian also claimed China has the "understanding and support" of the "majority" of PIF members and has made its position "very clear" to Palau.

This year's PIF has been mired in controversy ahead of its official start, with six leaders confirmed as no-shows, including outgoing forum chair and Solomon Islands Prime Minister Mathew Wale, as well as Kiribati's pro-Beijing president Taneti Maamau, who has pointedly sent his former ambassador to China, David Teabo, in his place instead.

Reasons for their absences range from national parliamentary duties and health, with Wale having arrived in Koror and forced to return home on the weekend to face a possible leadership challenge. But key leaders missing have cast doubt over whether there could be meaningful collective action on key agenda items at the three-day event, including on climate action...
body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: As leaders gather in Palau for the Pacific Islands Forum, diplomatic tensions simmer. China's envoy has voiced strong objections to Taiwan's participation, warning of 'consequences.' In such moments of heightened political friction, the call to pursue peace and seek diplomatic solutions, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 在太平洋岛国论坛领导人在帕劳举行会议之际，外交紧张局势悄然升温。中国特使对台湾的参与表达了强烈反对，并警告将有“后果”。在政治摩擦加剧的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与外交解决方案的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

title.en: Race to rescue hundreds trapped in tunnels as Nepal flood death toll tops 950
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾死亡人数超950人，救援人员争分夺秒营救被困隧道工人

summary.en: Rescuers are urgently working to free hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were inundated by mud from catastrophic flooding along the Nepal-China border. The combined death toll in Nepal and China has surpassed 950, with over 4400 people missing. At least 900 workers are unaccounted for at...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-中国边境发生灾难性洪水后，救援人员正争分夺秒地营救被埋在水电站隧道中的数百名工人。尼泊尔和中国的合计死亡人数已超过950人，另有超过4400人失踪。受洪水影响的12个水电项目至少有900名工人下落不明。

body.en:
Rescuers are racing to free hundreds of workers believed to be trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were buried in mud by catastrophic flooding on the Nepal-China border as the death toll climbs and increasingly desperate families searched for missing loved ones.

The combined deaths in Nepal and China surpassed 950, with more than 4400 people — including 43 Australians — missing.

A private-sector association representing power companies said at least 900 workers were unaccounted for at 12 hydropower projects damaged by the flash floods in Nepal's Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts.

At least one expert said that some workers could have access to oxygen, but others warned that the chances of finding survivors were diminishing.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As the rescue efforts intensified, four bodies were recovered from three mud-filled tunnels, Nepal's army said.

Some workers managed to call for help when the disaster struck last Wednesday, and others who managed to flee reported to authorities and relatives that many of their colleagues were still in the tunnels, said Mohan Kumar Dangi, president of the Independent Power Producers' Association.

It was unclear whether rescuers have had any contact with the trapped workers since the initial calls for help.

Six days after the disaster, fears were growing that some might have suffocated, Dangi said.

Rescue efforts were focused on people trapped in the gigantic tunnels built for controlling the flow of water.

"These tunnels are big enough to drive trucks through," said Jakob Steiner, a geoscientist at the University of Graz in Austria based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

"And from what we understand, they have managed to get oxygen to some of those stuck inside and are trying to rescue them now. It's a race for time, though, as people need food and water."

In the Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project, in the hard-hit Rasuwa district, at least 576 people were missing, Dangi said, adding that about 300 of them were believed to be trapped inside the project's tunnel.

At the Trishuli-3 Hydropower Project, crews were working to descend about 15 metres into a tunnel in an effort to reach those believed trapped inside, according to Nepali army spokesman Brigadier General Raja Ram Basnet.

Workers shovelling mud from a flood-ravaged power station in Dhading, Nepal, said the station is a key connection for providing power to more than 20,000 people in the region.

On the Chinese side, rescue and recovery efforts included rebuilding the road leading to the Gyirong Port border crossing that regulated travel between China and Nepal.

Trucks carried giant rocks as workers tried to repave a...
body.zh: 随着死亡人数不断攀升，以及越来越绝望的家庭寻找失踪亲人，救援人员正在竞相营救数百名据信被困在水电站隧道中的工人，这些工人因尼泊尔和中国边境的灾难性洪水而被埋在泥土中。 尼泊尔和中国的死亡人数合计超过 950 人，超过 4400 人失踪，其中包括 43 名澳大利亚人。 代表电力公司的私营部门协会表示，尼泊尔拉苏瓦和努瓦科特地区因山洪爆发而受损的 12 个水电项目中，至少有 900 名工人下落不明。 至少一位专家表示，一些工人可以获得氧气，但其他专家警告说，找到幸存者的机会正在减少。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尼泊尔军方表示，随着救援工作的加强，从三个充满泥浆的隧道中找到了四具尸体。 独立电力生产商协会主席莫汉·库马尔·丹吉(Mohan Kumar Dangi)表示，上周三灾难发生时，一些工人设法寻求帮助，其他设法逃离的工人向当局和亲属报告，他们的许多同事仍在隧道里。 目前还不清楚自最初发出求救信号以来，救援人员是否与被困工人有过任何接触。 丹吉说，灾难发生六天后，人们越来越担心有些人可能会窒息而死。 救援工作的重点是被困在为控制水流而建造的巨大隧道中的人们。 “这些隧道足够大，可以让卡车通过，”位于孟加拉国达卡的奥地利格拉茨大学的地球科学家雅各布·施泰纳说。 “据我们了解，他们已经设法为一些被困在里面的人提供氧气，并正在努力营救他们。不过，这是一场时间竞赛，因为人们需要食物和水。” Dangi 说，在受灾最严重的 Rasuwa 地区的 Upper Trishuli-1 水电站项目中，至少有 576 人失踪，并补充说，其中约 300 人据信被困在该项目的隧道内。 尼泊尔陆军发言人 Raja Ram Basnet 准将表示，在 Trishuli-3 水电项目中，工作人员正在努力下潜到隧道内约 15 米处，以营救被困在隧道内的人员。 尼泊尔达丁一座遭受洪水破坏的发电站的工人们正在铲泥，他们表示，该发电站是为该地区 2 万多人提供电力的关键线路。 中方的救援和恢复工作包括重建通往吉隆口岸的道路，该口岸负责控制中尼之间的交通。 当工人们试图重新铺设道路时，卡车运载着巨大的岩石。

reflection.en: The news from the Nepal-China border is grim, with hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels following catastrophic floods. In such moments, the cry of the vulnerable echoes, reminding us of the biblical call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. May we be moved to advocate for the safety and rescue of these individuals, reflecting the compassion...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-中国边境传来的消息令人心痛，数百名工人在灾难性的洪水后被困于隧道之中。在这样的时刻，弱者的呼喊回响，提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为那些无法为自己发声的人说话。愿我们被触动，为这些人的安全和救援而倡导，体现《箴言》31:8-9所敦促我们的怜悯之心。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
