reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI offers new tools, but this study highlights a potential pitfall: relying on artificial intelligence for deep emotional needs may exacerbate feelings of isolation. While technology can assist, genuine human connection and support remain vital for emotional well-being. It prompts us to consider whether every technological...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展提供了新的工具，但这项研究揭示了一个潜在的陷阱：依赖人工智能来满足深层情感需求，可能会加剧孤立感。技术可以提供帮助，但真正的人际联系和支持对于情感健康仍然至关重要。这促使我们思考，是否每一项技术能力都服务于我们最深层的人类需求。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Role of ethics education in accounting fraud prevention
title.zh: 伦理教育在会计欺诈预防中的作用

summary.en: Two faculty members at SUNY Polytechnic Institute are investigating how to embed ethics and values throughout accounting and business education to better equip students to identify and prevent workplace fraud.
summary.zh: 纽约州立理工学院（SUNY Poly）商学院的两名教员正在研究如何将伦理和价值观融入会计和商业教育的各个环节，以更好地培养学生识别和预防工作中欺诈行为的能力。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Two SUNY Polytechnic Institute (SUNY Poly) College of Business faculty members are exploring how integrating ethics and values throughout accounting and business education can better prepare students to recognize and prevent fraud in the workplace.

Dr. Katie Matt, assistant professor of accounting, and Dr. Lisa Berardino, associate professor of management, co-authored "An Integrated Approach to Developing Students' Ethical Values for Accounting Fraud Prevention: Aligning Course Learning Objectives with the Elements of Fraud," published in the Business Education Innovation Journal .

The research addresses fraud as a growing concern for organizations and examines the important role that individual ethics, values and integrity can play in preventing fraudulent behavior. Using the Fraud Triangle , which focuses on pressure, opportunity and rationalization, as a framework, Matt and Berardino propose incorporating ethical decision-making and values-based learning throughout accounting and business curricula.

Rather than limiting ethics education to standalone courses, the authors recommend embedding ethics-based learning objectives across a student's program of study. Through curriculum mapping and an interdisciplinary approach, courses in accounting, strategic management, organizational behavior, human resource management and the humanities can help students examine personal values, organizational culture, workplace pressures and other factors that can contribute to fraud.

The proposed learning objectives include helping students evaluate real-world fraud cases, recognize common fraud risk indicators, understand how workplace culture can influence decision-making and identify how emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence may create new fraud risks.

Ultimately, the business researchers argue that developing students' ethical values and professional integrity throughout their education can better prepare future accounting and business professionals to navigate difficult workplace situations, recognize fraud risks and make ethical decisions throughout their careers.

Katie Matt and Lisa Berardino, An Integrated Approach to Developing Students' Ethical Values for Accounting Fraud Prevention: Aligning Course Learning Objectives with the Elements of Fraud, Business Education Innovation Journal (2026)

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 纽约州立大学理工学院 (SUNY Poly) 商学院的两名教员正在探索如何将道德和价值观融入会计和商业教育中，以便更好地帮助学生认识和预防工作场所欺诈。 会计学助理教授 Katie Matt 博士和管理学副教授 Lisa Berardino 博士合着了《培养学生道德价值观以预防会计欺诈的综合方法：使课程学习目标与欺诈要素保持一致》，发表在《商业教育创新杂志》上。 该研究将欺诈作为组织日益关注的问题，并探讨了个人道德、价值观和诚信在防止欺诈行为中可以发挥的重要作用。马特和贝拉迪诺以关注压力、机会和合理化的欺诈三角为框架，建议将道德决策和基于价值观的学习纳入整个会计和商业课程。 作者建议不要将道德教育限制在独立的课程中，而是将基于道德的学习目标嵌入到学生的学习计划中。通过课程规划和跨学科方法，会计、战略管理、组织行为、人力资源管理和人文学科课程可以帮助学生检查个人价值观、组织文化、工作场所压力和其他可能导致欺诈的因素。 拟议的学习目标包括帮助学生评估现实世界的欺诈案例，识别常见的欺诈风险指标，了解工作场所文化如何影响决策，以及识别人工智能等新兴技术如何创造新的欺诈风险。 最终，商业研究人员认为，在整个教育过程中培养学生的道德价值观和职业诚信可以更好地为未来的会计和商业专业人士做好准备，以应对困难的工作场所情况，识别欺诈风险并在整个职业生涯中做出道德决策。 Katie Matt 和 Lisa Berardino，《培养学生预防会计欺诈道德价值观的综合方法：使课程学习目标与欺诈要素保持一致》，《商业教育创新期刊》（2026 年） 艺术史学士，物质文化硕士。前博物馆编辑、护理人员和移植协调员。自 2021 年起为 Science X 编辑。完整档案 → 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 中发挥关键作用...

With a...

body.en: A research team from The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) has developed an innovative "one-pot" testing platform, known as TEMPO, that could transform highly sensitive nucleic acid testing from a laboratory-based procedure into a simple, single-step test that can be performed at home. With a single reaction tube, users can obtain results comparable to those of professional laboratory tests in as little as 30 minutes. The breakthrough has the potential to bridge the technological gap between existing rapid tests and laboratory-based nucleic acid diagnostics, offering a more convenient solution for future infectious disease surveillance and genetic screening.
body.zh: 香港科技大学（科大）的研究团队开发了一种创新的“一锅式”检测平台，称为TEMPO，可以将高度敏感的核酸检测从基于实验室的程序转变为可以在家中进行的简单的单步检测。只需一根反应管，用户只需30分钟即可获得与专业实验室测试相媲美的结果。这一突破有可能弥合现有快速检测和基于实验室的核酸诊断之间的技术差距，为未来的传染病监测和基因筛查提供更便捷的解决方案。

reflection.en: The relentless pace of scientific discovery continues to accelerate, bringing complex laboratory procedures into the realm of everyday accessibility. This new testing platform, developed by HKUST researchers, exemplifies how human ingenuity can make sophisticated diagnostics available in minutes, right at home. It reminds us of the biblical observation that...
reflection.zh: 科学发现的步伐不断加快，将复杂的实验室程序带入了日常可及的领域。香港科技大学研究人员开发的这一新型检测平台，体现了人类的智慧如何能在几分钟内，在家中就能获得复杂的诊断结果。它让我们想起圣经中的观察：“知识必然增长”，这一趋势在我们不断发展的技术中显而易见。

verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

title.en: Did you solve it? The fin-tastic fish puzzle
title.zh: 你解出来了吗？鱼的奇妙谜题

summary.en: The solution to today’s underwater conundrums. A fish is swimming in a tank that is two metres high, one metre across and one metre deep. The image below shows one path it swam. The puzzles asked readers to draw the top view of the shortest path that results in given front and side views.

body.en:
Earlier today I set you the following puzzles. Here they are again with the solutions.

A fish is swimming in a tank that is two metres high, one metre across and one metre deep. The image below shows one path it swam.

I gave two examples of a front and side view, and asked you to draw the top view of the shortest path that results in those views.

Start off by looking at the cross section defined by the vertical line of the 1. The diagonal of the 7 has to be on that plane, as does the horizontal part of the 7. The final segment has to be on the area I shaded in above right. The top view is thus:

The bottom half of the path must fall on the shaded cross section above left. Likewise, the top section (excluding the very top and middle of the tank) must fall on the shaded cross section above centre. We want the shortest path, so there is only one way to join the bottom part of the path to the top part, and to link the path on the top cross section, above right. The top view is thus:

Today’s puzzles were created by maths educator George Watkins to celebrate the opening of the 1729 Maths School , which welcomes its first pupils later this month.

The school – in Mill Hill, north London – is the first specialist maths secondary school to open in the UK. Its name comes from a famous anecdote about a London taxi cab with the licence plate 1729 .

I’ve been setting a puzzle here on alternate Mondays since 2015. I’m always on the look-out for great puzzles. If you would like to suggest one, email me .
body.zh: 今天早些时候，我给你设置了以下难题。他们再次给出了解决方案。 一条鱼在一个两米高、一米宽、一米深的水箱里游泳。下图显示了它游过的一条路径。 我给出了前视图和侧视图的两个示例，并要求您绘制产生这些视图的最短路径的俯视图。 首先查看由 1 的垂直线定义的横截面。7 的对角线必须位于该平面上，7 的水平部分也必须位于该平面上。最后一段必须位于右上方阴影区域。俯视图是这样的： 路径的下半部分必须落在左上方的阴影横截面上。同样，顶部部分（不包括水箱的最顶部和中间）必须落在中心上方的阴影横截面上。我们想要最短的路径，因此只有一种方法可以将路径的底部部分连接到顶部部分，并链接顶部横截面上的路径（右上方）。俯视图是这样的： 今天的谜题是由数学教育家乔治·沃特金斯 (George Watkins) 创建的，旨在庆祝 1729 年数学学校的开学，该学校将于本月晚些时候迎来第一批学生。 这所学校位于伦敦北部的米尔山，是英国第一所开设的专业数学中学。它的名字来源于关于伦敦一辆牌照为1729的出租车的著名轶事。 自 2015 年以来，我一直在每隔一个星期一在这里设置一个谜题。我总是在寻找很棒的谜题。如果您想推荐一个，请给我发电子邮件。

reflection.en: This puzzle invites us to observe the intricate movements of a creature within its environment. The Bible reminds us that much wisdom can be found by observing the natural world around us, as even the creatures of the earth can teach us. May we approach all of creation with a spirit of curiosity and reverence, seeking to understand the Creator through His...
reflection.zh: 这个谜题邀请我们观察生物在其环境中错综复杂的运动。圣经提醒我们，通过观察周围的自然世界可以获得许多智慧，因为就连地上的生物也能教导我们。愿我们以好奇和敬畏的心态对待万物，通过祂的作品来认识创造主。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Popular sweeteners may leave effects that last for generations
title.zh: 流行甜味剂可能留下影响数代的效果

summary.en: Two common zero-calorie sweeteners, sucralose and stevia, may have lasting effects beyond their taste. Research in mice showed they altered the gut microbiome, reduced beneficial bacterial compounds, and changed gene activity related to metabolism and inflammation. Notably, some of these changes were observed in...
summary.zh: 两种常用的零卡路里甜味剂，三氯蔗糖和甜菊糖，可能产生比甜味本身更持久的影响。在小鼠研究中，研究人员发现这两种甜味剂都改变了肠道微生物组，减少了肠道细菌产生的有益化合物，并改变了与新陈代谢和炎症相关的基因活动。其中一些变化甚至出现在从未食用过这些甜味剂的后代中。

body.en: Two widely used zero-calorie sweeteners, sucralose and stevia, may have effects that linger far longer than the sweet taste itself. In mice, researchers found that both sweeteners altered the gut microbiome, reduced beneficial compounds produced by gut bacteria, and changed the activity of genes involved in metabolism and inflammation. Some of those changes were also detected in later generations that had never consumed the sweeteners themselves.
body.zh: 两种广泛使用的零热量甜味剂，三氯蔗糖和甜叶菊，其影响可能比甜味本身更持久。在小鼠中，研究人员发现这两种甜味剂改变了肠道微生物组，减少了肠道细菌产生的有益化合物，并改变了参与代谢和炎症的基因的活性。其中一些变化也在从未食用过甜味剂的后代中被发现。

reflection.en: The relentless advance of scientific knowledge, as seen in this study on sweeteners, continually reveals new layers of complexity in the world around us. Daniel's prophecy speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, a phenomenon we witness daily as research uncovers connections previously unknown, even across generations.
reflection.zh: 科学知识的不断进步，正如这项关于甜味剂的研究所示，不断揭示我们周围世界的新层面的复杂性。但以理的预言谈到末世知识必增长，我们每天都在见证这一现象，研究揭示了以前未知的联系，甚至跨越了世代。

title.en: Scientists discover two superconducting states hiding as one
title.zh: 科学家发现两种隐藏在一起的超导态

summary.en: Scientists have discovered hidden complexity within two ultrathin superconductors, niobium diselenide and tantalum disulfide, which previously appeared to have only a single superconducting state. Highly sensitive measurements revealed that each material actually possesses two distinct superconducting states.
summary.zh: 科学家们在两种超薄的超导体——二硒化铌和二硫化钽——中发现了隐藏的复杂性，而这两种超导体此前似乎只有一个超导态。高灵敏度的测量显示，每种材料实际上都拥有两种不同的超导态。

body.en:
Uncovering this hidden structure could eventually allow researchers to design superconducting materials and devices with greater control and precision. As scientists pursue quantum computers, ultra-efficient electronics, and other advanced technologies, a detailed understanding of how electrons behave inside superconductors will become increasingly important.

Some scientific surprises emerge not from discovering something entirely new, but from taking a closer look at something researchers thought they already understood.

For decades, physicists have investigated superconductors —materials capable of carrying electrical current with zero energy loss . Their unusual properties could eventually support technologies ranging from ultra-efficient electronics and quantum computers to advanced medical systems.

One of the best-studied examples is niobium diselenide (NbSe 2 ) . When researchers reduced the material to only a few atomic layers, experiments appeared to show relatively simple superconducting behavior. In particular, the material seemed to have a single energy gap, a key characteristic that reflects how electrons pair together so they can move without electrical resistance.

Researchers, however, had reason to suspect that this simple picture was incomplete.

The study was led by PhD. student Shahar Simon and MSc. student Maya Klang under the guidance of Prof. Oded Millo, and Prof. Hadar Steinberg of the Racah Institute of Physics and the Center for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem . The research was published in Physical Review Letters .

With highly sensitive tunneling spectroscopy measurements, the researchers found that NbSe 2 does not behave like a straightforward superconductor governed by only one superconducting order. Instead, it contains two different superconducting orders that interact so strongly they appear as one .

The researchers identified the same concealed behavior in the closely related material TaS 2 .

"It's a bit like listening to what sounds like a single singer, only to discover it's actually a perfectly synchronized duet," said the researchers.

The finding provides an explanation for a puzzle that had remained unresolved for years. Traditional theories could not fully reproduce the detailed shape of the superconducting energy spectrum seen in earlier experiments.

By using a more advanced model that includes two distinct superconducting orders, the Hebrew University researchers were able to explain the experimental measurements much more accurately. The same approach also accounted for how the materials behave when magnetic fields are applied.

The results point to additional complexity in thicker forms of the material. According to the findings, bulk NbSe 2 may contain...
body.zh: 揭示这种隐藏的结构最终可以让研究人员能够设计出具有更高控制力和精度的超导材料和设备。随着科学家追求量子计算机、超高效电子学和其他先进技术，详细了解电子在超导体内的行为将变得越来越重要。 一些科学惊喜并不是来自于发现全新的东西，而是来自于更仔细地研究研究人员认为他们已经理解的东西。 几十年来，物理学家一直在研究超导体——一种能够以零能量损失传输电流的材料。它们不寻常的特性最终可以支持从超高效电子和量子计算机到先进医疗系统的技术。 研究最好的例子之一是二硒化铌 (NbSe 2 )。当研究人员将材料减少到只有几个原子层时，实验似乎显示出相对简单的超导行为。特别是，该材料似乎具有单一能隙，这是一个关键特征，反映了电子如何配对在一起，以便它们可以在没有电阻的情况下移动。 然而，研究人员有理由怀疑这张简单的图景并不完整。 该研究由博士领导。学生沙哈尔西蒙和理学硕士。学生 Maya Klang 在耶路撒冷希伯来大学拉卡物理研究所和纳米科学与纳米技术中心的 Oded Millo 教授和 Hadar Steinberg 教授的指导下进行。该研究发表在《物理评论快报》上。 通过高灵敏度的隧道光谱测量，研究人员发现 NbSe 2 的行为并不像仅受一种超导序控制的简单超导体。相反，它包含两种不同的超导秩序，它们相互作用如此强烈，以至于看起来像是一个。 研究人员在密切相关的材料 TaS 2 中发现了相同的隐藏行为。 研究人员说：“这有点像听一个歌手听起来像是一个歌手，却发现它实际上是一个完美同步的二重唱。” 这一发现为多年来悬而未决的谜题提供了解释。传统理论无法完全重现早期实验中看到的超导能谱的详细形状。 通过使用包含两个不同超导级的更先进模型，希伯来大学的研究人员能够更准确地解释实验测量结果。同样的方法还解释了材料在施加磁场时的行为。 结果表明，较厚的材料形式更加复杂。根据研究结果，散装 NbSe 2 可能含有...

reflection.en: The universe, like the materials studied here, holds profound depths that human curiosity and diligent effort can reveal. The pursuit of knowledge, even in the seemingly simple, uncovers layers of wonder, reflecting the glory of discovery itself. This persistent exploration mirrors our own journey of understanding Yahweh's creation and His intricate designs.
reflection.zh: 宇宙，如同这里研究的材料一样，蕴藏着深邃的奥秘，等待着人类的好奇心和不懈努力去揭示。对知识的追求，即使是在看似简单的领域，也能揭示出层层奇迹，这本身就彰显了发现的荣耀。这种持续的探索，也呼应着我们理解雅伟的创造及其精妙设计的旅程。

title.en: Smelling test: children need education in sniffing aromas, scientist says

summary.en: Dr. Will Tullett, a historian of smells from the University of York, argues that children need better education in understanding aromas. He suggests that this improved olfactory education can enhance their well-being and their perception of the world. Tullett also notes that pollution can impair smell and that many...
summary.zh: 来自约克大学的气味历史学家威尔·塔利特博士认为，儿童需要更好地学习理解香气。他提出，这种改进的嗅觉教育可以提升他们的福祉和对世界的感知能力。塔利特博士还指出，污染会损害嗅觉，并且许多现代产品都去除了天然气味，代之以合成香料。

body.en: Exclusive: Dr Will Tullett says better understanding of scents can improve wellbeing and perception of the world Children need a better education in sniffing aromas, a leading historian of smells has said, noting it may improve their wellbeing and help them understand the world around them. Dr Will Tullett, of the University of York, said pollution had been found to impair people’s olfactory abilities, while many objects and substances today – from margarines to car interiors and even our own homes – were stripped of their original smells and “reodourised” with synthetic scents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：威尔·塔利特博士表示，更好地理解气味可以改善幸福感和对世界的感知 一位著名的气味历史学家表示，孩子们需要接受更好的嗅香教育，并指出这可能会改善他们的幸福感并帮助他们了解周围的世界。约克大学的威尔·塔利特博士表示，污染已被发现会损害人们的嗅觉能力，而今天的许多物体和物质——从人造黄油到汽车内饰，甚至我们自己的家——都失去了原来的气味，并用合成气味“重新散发”气味。继续阅读...

Just as the heavens declare God's glory, so too can the subtle nuances of scent reveal the intricate design and wonder of His handiwork, enriching our lives and well-being.
reflection.zh: 威尔·塔利特博士呼吁加强嗅觉教育，这提醒我们，上帝的创造充满了感官体验，可以加深我们对世界的理解和欣赏。正如诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，气味的细微差别也能揭示祂化工的精巧设计和奇妙之处，从而丰富我们的生活和福祉。

title.en: Scientists challenge a 70-year-old “lizard brain” myth
title.zh: 科学家挑战“爬行动物大脑”的70年神话

summary.en: A long-standing view of brain evolution, picturing newer rational layers stacked on an ancient "lizard brain," may be misleading. New research suggests evolution balances competing wiring styles, expanding one while shrinking another, rather than a simple layering of old over new.
summary.zh: 一个关于大脑进化的长期观点，将较新的理性层堆叠在古老的“爬行动物大脑”之上，可能具有误导性。新的研究表明，进化似乎是在平衡两种相互竞争的布线方式，扩展一种而缩小另一种，而不是简单地将旧的覆盖在新的之上。

body.en:
Many important choices seem to pit reason against emotion. Popular culture often describes that tension as a contest between two parts of the brain: a newer, more advanced center for rational thought and an ancient "lizard brain" that runs on instinct.

But the evolutionary history of the brain appears to be far more complicated than a simple struggle between old and new.

"There was a theory proposed in the '50s that the brain evolved in layers starting with basic bodily functions, to emotions in the reptilian brain, leading up to sophisticated reasoning in humans," explains Nabil Imam, an assistant professor in the School of Computational Science and Engineering and a faculty member with Georgia Tech's Institute for Neuroscience, Neurotechnology, and Society (INNS). "This is not how an evolutionary biologist would think about the problem."

Research published in Science Advances suggests that brain evolution may be better understood in terms of wiring rather than newer regions being stacked on top of older ones.

By examining the organization of both biological brains and artificial neural networks, Imam and his colleagues found evidence that evolution may involve allocating a limited amount of brain space among competing wiring strategies. Their model describes a computational tug of war between two fundamentally different kinds of neural organization, both of which are established even before birth.

The findings could help explain a long-running puzzle in brain evolution and may also point toward new ways of building AI systems that use less data and energy.

Terms such as "logical brain" and "lizard brain" actually refer to groups of brain regions with very different functions. The neocortex, often associated with higher-level thought, forms the outer layer of the brain and is involved in vision, perception, reasoning, and other complex abilities.

"The limbic system, sometimes called the 'reptilian brain,' controls emotion broadly speaking -- but it also has other components with distinct functions," explains Imam. The system contains separate regions involved in memory, smell, navigation, and emotional regulation. "Why do people group all these different regions into one big system? There hasn't been a good theory for what is common between these different circuits."

To explore that question, the researchers compared how these brain systems change across species. Rather than looking at individual regions one at a time, they examined how the limbic system and neocortex vary together over evolutionary history.

A clear pattern emerged. When one part of the limbic system was relatively large, the other limbic regions also tended to be larger. At the same time, the neocortex was generally smaller.

"Rather," says Imam, "it's a coordinated...
body.zh: 许多重要的选择似乎都是理性与情感的对立。流行文化经常将这种紧张关系描述为大脑的两个部分之间的竞争：一个更新、更先进的理性思维中心和一个依靠本能运行的古老“蜥蜴大脑”。 但大脑的进化史似乎比新旧之间的简单斗争要复杂得多。 乔治亚理工学院计算科学与工程学院助理教授、佐治亚理工学院神经科学、神经技术和社会研究所 (INNS) 的教员纳比尔·伊玛姆 (Nabil Imam) 解释说：“上世纪 50 年代提出了一种理论，认为大脑是分层进化的，从基本的身体功能开始，到爬行动物大脑的情感，最后发展到人类复杂的推理。” “这不是进化生物学家思考这个问题的方式。” 发表在《科学进展》上的研究表明，大脑的进化可以通过布线来更好地理解，而不是通过将新区域堆叠在旧区域之上来理解。 通过检查生物大脑和人工神经网络的组织，伊玛目和他的同事发现了证据，表明进化可能涉及在相互竞争的布线策略之间分配有限的大脑空间。他们的模型描述了两种根本不同的神经组织之间的计算拉锯战，这两种组织甚至在出生前就已经建立了。 这些发现可能有助于解释大脑进化中长期存在的难题，也可能指出构建使用更少数据和能源的人工智能系统的新方法。 “逻辑脑”和“蜥蜴脑”等术语实际上是指功能截然不同的大脑区域组。新皮质通常与更高层次的思维相关，形成大脑的外层，涉及视觉、感知、推理和其他复杂的能力。 “边缘系统，有时被称为‘爬虫类大脑’，广义上控制着情绪——但它也有其他具有不同功能的组件，”伊玛目解释道。该系统包含涉及记忆、嗅觉、导航和情绪调节的独立区域。 “为什么人们将所有这些不同的区域归为一个大系统？目前还没有一个好的理论来解释这些不同电路之间的共同点。” 为了探索这个问题，研究人员比较了这些大脑系统在不同物种之间的变化。他们没有一次只观察一个区域，而是研究了边缘系统和新皮质在进化史上如何共同变化。 一个清晰的模式出现了。当边缘系统的一部分相对较大时，其他边缘区域也往往较大。与此同时，新皮质普遍较小。 “相反，”伊玛目说，“这是一个协调的......

reflection.en: The popular image of the brain as a layered structure, with a primal "lizard brain" beneath our rational thought, is being challenged by new research. This reminds us that the intricate workings of creation, even within ourselves, often hold deeper wisdom than our current understanding allows. Observing the complexity of the brain's evolution, rather than...
reflection.zh: 大脑被描绘成一个分层结构，在我们理性思维之下有一个原始的“爬行动物大脑”，这种流行观念正受到新研究的挑战。这提醒我们，造物的复杂运作，即使在我们自身之内，也常常蕴含着比我们当前理解更深刻的智慧。观察大脑进化的复杂性，而不是依赖于简单的模型，可以让我们更深刻地欣赏雅伟的设计。

title.en: Fossil feet may be misleading scientists about human evolution
title.zh: 化石脚可能误导科学家关于人类进化

summary.en: New research reveals that wild monkeys in West Africa possess a previously unrecognized foot flexibility that enables them to climb vertical tree trunks. This finding challenges a fundamental assumption about the locomotion and appearance of the last common ancestor of humans and chimpanzees, impacting our...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，西非的野生猴子拥有先前未被认识到的足部灵活性，使其能够攀爬垂直的树干。这一发现挑战了关于人类和黑猩猩最后共同祖先的运动能力和外貌的一个基本假设，从而影响了我们对人类进化的理解。

body.en:
New research suggests that whatever scientists ultimately discover about the last common ancestor of humans and chimpanzees, one characteristic may be difficult to dispute: it was probably capable of climbing trees.

Humans and chimpanzees went their separate evolutionary ways between 6 and 7 million years ago, when they diverged from the last common ancestor (LCA) they once shared. Reconstructing that ancestor has become an important part of understanding human evolution, including the emergence of walking on two legs.

One major question concerns where and how the LCA moved through forests. Did it spend much of its time among high horizontal branches, climb vertically from the ground, or combine both behaviors?

Chimpanzees are highly capable tree trunk climbers, aided by ankles that can flex much farther than human ankles. Monkeys, by contrast, have often been viewed as relying more heavily on their arms to move through trees. That distinction has influenced ideas about whether the human-chimpanzee ancestor should have possessed feet more like those of modern apes or monkeys.

Researchers from The Ohio State University studied wild sooty mangabey monkeys, whose feet do not have the same highly flexible ankles found in chimpanzees. Detailed observations and measurements showed that the monkeys can nevertheless bend parts of their feet enough to climb narrow vertical tree trunks while seeking food, hiding or finding places to sleep.

"People are making behavioral inferences from fossils, and some say a monkey can't vertically climb as well as an ape can," said first study author Luke Fannin, assistant professor of anthropology at Ohio State. "We're saying there's a functional equivalence here. So you can't rule out vertical climbing just because something doesn't have a chimpanzee-like foot."

The research appears this week in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences .

Determining what the LCA looked like and how it moved could help researchers understand the evolutionary steps that eventually produced habitual bipedalism, a form of movement practiced regularly only by humans.

Humans are apes, but the new findings suggest that an ancestor with feet resembling those of monkeys might still have been capable of climbing in ways comparable to modern apes.

"Part of paleoanthropology is understanding how our evolution happened, and it's often through the hallmark of how we move because modern humans move quite differently than our cousins, the chimpanzees, do, and they're the living primate we're most closely related to," Fannin said. "And we're trying to understand why that is."

Fannin collected video of wild mangabeys at the Taï Forest Monkey Project field station in Ivory Coast. The project is co-directed by W. Scott McGraw, professor...
body.zh: 新的研究表明，无论科学家最终发现人类和黑猩猩最后的共同祖先，有一个特征可能很难争议：它可能能够爬树。 人类和黑猩猩在 6 至 700 万年前走上了各自的进化道路，当时它们与曾经共同的最后一个共同祖先 (LCA) 分道扬镳。重建祖先已成为理解人类进化的重要组成部分，包括两条腿走路的出现。 一个主要问题涉及 LCA 在何处以及如何穿过森林。它是否将大部分时间花在高水平的树枝上、从地面垂直攀爬，或者将这两种行为结合起来？ 黑猩猩是非常有能力攀爬树干的人，它们的脚踝比人类的脚踝弯曲得更远。相比之下，猴子通常被认为更依赖手臂在树林中移动。这种区别影响了关于人类-黑猩猩祖先是否应该拥有更像现代猿或猴子的脚的想法。 俄亥俄州立大学的研究人员研究了野生黑白眉猴，它们的脚不像黑猩猩那样具有高度灵活的脚踝。详细的观察和测量表明，猴子在寻找食物、躲藏或寻找睡觉的地方时，仍然可以弯曲部分脚，爬上狭窄的垂直树干。 “人们正在根据化石做出行为推断，有人说猴子不能像猿一样垂直攀爬，”该研究的第一作者、俄亥俄州立大学人类学助理教授卢克·范宁说。 “我们说这里存在功能上的等同性。所以你不能仅仅因为某些东西没有像黑猩猩一样的脚就排除垂直攀爬。” 该研究发表在本周的《美国国家科学院院刊》上。 确定 LCA 的样子以及它如何移动可以帮助研究人员了解最终产生习惯性两足行走的进化步骤，这是一种只有人类经常练习的运动形式。 人类是猿类，但新的发现表明，脚部与猴子相似的祖先可能仍然能够以与现代猿类相当的方式攀爬。 范宁说：“古人类学的一部分是了解我们的进化是如何发生的，这通常是通过我们如何移动的标志来了解的，因为现代人类的移动方式与我们的近亲黑猩猩完全不同，而它们是与我们关系最密切的现存灵长类动物。” “我们正在试图理解这是为什么。” 范宁在科特迪瓦的塔伊森林猴项目野外站收集了野生白眉猴的视频。该项目由 W. Scott McGraw 教授共同指导...

reflection.en: The intricate design of creation often holds lessons that surprise us. Even the seemingly simple act of a monkey climbing a tree can reveal complexities that reshape our understanding of life's history. As we observe the natural world, we are reminded that wisdom is often found in the details, waiting to be discovered through careful study and observation.
reflection.zh: 造物的精妙设计常常蕴含着令我们惊讶的教训。即使是猴子攀爬树木这样看似简单的行为，也能揭示出重塑我们对生命历史理解的复杂性。当我们观察自然世界时，我们被提醒，智慧常常隐藏在细节之中，等待着通过仔细的研究和观察而被发现。

title.en: Space junk punched a new hole in the moon. It’s not ours to abuse | Moriba Jah
title.zh: 太空垃圾在月球上打了个新洞。我们无权滥用它

summary.en: A piece of defunct SpaceX rocket debris impacted the Moon on August 5th, creating a new crater near Einstein Crater. While astronomers observed the resulting plume of sodium and lithium, the incident highlights the growing problem of space junk and the lack of accountability within the space industry for discarding...
summary.zh: 8月5日，一块报废的SpaceX火箭残骸撞击了月球，在爱因斯坦陨石坑附近形成了一个新陨石坑。天文学家观测到了由此产生的钠和锂的羽状物，但这一事件凸显了太空垃圾日益增长的问题，以及太空行业在轨道上随意丢弃废弃物而缺乏问责制的情况。

body.en: The space industry treats the sky as a place to dump what it no longer wants. We must develop a new model of accountability On 5 August, a piece of a derelict SpaceX rocket traveling at 5,400 miles an hour met with the moon and punched a fresh hole into it near Einstein Crater . Astronomers were thrilled. The European Southern Observatory caught sodium and lithium flaring in the debris plume and called it a bonus. The media called it a light show. Nobody was physically hurt, so nobody is responsible, and within a week the story was gone. I have spent 20 years tracking the junk humanity leaves behind in space for a living, and I want to tell you plainly what that crater actually is: a receipt. It’s what you get when an entire industry treats the sky, and now the moon, as a place to dump what it no longer wants, and calls the dumping “normal operations” or “space exploration”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 航天工业将天空视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方。我们必须制定新的问责模式 8 月 5 日，一枚废弃 SpaceX 火箭的一块碎片以每小时 5,400 英里的速度与月球相遇，并在爱因斯坦陨石坑附近的月球上砸出了一个新的洞。天文学家们兴奋不已。欧洲南方天文台在碎片羽流中发现了钠和锂的燃烧，并将其称为额外奖励。媒体称其为灯光秀。没有人受到身体伤害，所以没有人负责，一周之内这个故事就消失了。我花了 20 年的时间追踪人类在太空中留下的垃圾为生，我想清楚地告诉你那个陨石坑实际上是什么：一张收据。当整个行业将天空和现在的月球视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方，并将倾倒称为“正常操作”或“太空探索”时，你就会得到这样的结果。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a rocket fragment creating a new crater on the Moon serves as a stark reminder of our stewardship over creation, both on Earth and beyond. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This includes the vastness of space and the celestial bodies within it, which are not ours to defile with our waste.
reflection.zh: 火箭碎片在月球上造成新陨石坑的新闻，提醒我们对创造物的管家职分，无论是在地球上还是在地球之外。诗篇24:1提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。”这包括浩瀚的太空及其中的天体，它们并非我们可随意用垃圾玷污之物。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope launches to reveal the Universe’s darkest secrets
title.zh: NASA的罗马空间望远镜发射，揭示宇宙最黑暗的秘密

summary.en: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has begun a three-month journey covering roughly one million miles as it travels toward its final orbit. The observatory lifted off at 7:26 a.m. EDT Sunday aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Once operational,...
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的南希·格蕾丝·罗马空间望远镜已开始为期三个月的旅程，行程约一百万英里，前往其最终轨道。该天文台于周日上午东部夏令时7:26，由SpaceX猎鹰重型火箭从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39A发射台升空。投入使用后，罗马望远镜将结合其敏锐的红外视野和异常宽广的天空视野。这种组合将使天文学家能够检查...

body.en:
NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has begun a three-month journey covering roughly one million miles as it travels toward its final orbit. The observatory lifted off at 7:26 a.m. EDT Sunday aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Once operational, Roman will combine sharp infrared vision with an unusually wide view of the sky. That combination will allow astronomers to examine enormous regions of space while also looking far back into cosmic history. Among its primary goals are studying dark matter, dark energy, and worlds outside of our solar system, known as exoplanets. Its sweeping observations are also expected to support many discoveries beyond those central objectives.

"Roman is exactly the kind of success story we want to see across NASA," said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. "Delivered ahead of schedule and on budget, this mission reflects more than a decade of dedication from the NASA workforce and our industry partners. Now, Roman will give us a new atlas of the universe, push the boundaries of discovery, and demonstrate what is possible when America's space program pairs bold ambition with disciplined execution."

Controllers at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland, started receiving telemetry from Roman just seven minutes after launch. Falcon Heavy operated as planned and separated from the observatory 31 minutes after liftoff. After detaching from the rocket's center core, the two boosters returned safely to the launch site, where they can be refurbished.

"Roman will be a discovery machine that will bring us closer than ever before to answering humanity's most profound questions about our cosmic history," said Nicky Fox, associate administrator for the Science Mission Directorate at NASA Headquarters in Washington. "With its large field of view and fast survey speeds, Roman will usher us into a new era of discovery and make the invisible visible, setting the foundation for humanity's search for life beyond our solar system."

During the first part of the mission, Roman communicates with controllers using the Near Space Network, a system of ground stations and relay satellites that handles tracking, telemetry, and commands. Roughly 70 minutes after launch, communications shift to NASA's Deep Space Network, which will help guide the observatory toward the second Sun-Earth Lagrange point, or L2, about one million miles from Earth.

L2 is a region where the gravitational influences of the Sun and Earth allow spacecraft to maintain a relatively stable position with limited fuel use. Roman will first communicate through the Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex in Australia. Approximately six hours later, communications will transfer to the...
body.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜已开始为期三个月的旅程，覆盖约 100 万英里，朝着最终轨道运行。该天文台于美国东部时间周日上午 7 点 26 分搭乘 SpaceX 猎鹰重型火箭从佛罗里达州 NASA 肯尼迪航天中心的 39A 发射场升空。 一旦投入使用，罗曼将把敏锐的红外视觉与异常广阔的天空视野结合起来。这种结合将使天文学家能够检查巨大的太空区域，同时也可以回顾宇宙历史。其主要目标之一是研究暗物质、暗能量和太阳系之外的世界（即系外行星）。其广泛的观察也有望支持这些中心目标之外的许多发现。 “罗曼正是我们希望在 NASA 看到的那种成功故事，”NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 说道。 “这项任务在预算范围内提前完成，体现了 NASA 工作人员和行业合作伙伴十多年来的奉献精神。现在，罗曼将为我们提供一本新的宇宙地图，突破探索的界限，并展示当美国的太空计划将大胆的雄心与严格的执行相结合时，一切皆有可能。” 发射后仅七分钟，位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的控制人员就开始接收来自罗曼的遥测数据。猎鹰重型火箭按计划运行，并在升空 31 分钟后与天文台分离。与火箭中心核心分离后，两个助推器安全返回发射场，在那里可以进行翻新。 “罗曼将成为一台发现机器，它将让我们比以往任何时候都更接近回答人类关于宇宙历史的最深刻的问题，”美国宇航局华盛顿总部科学任务理事会副主任尼基·福克斯说。 “凭借其广阔的视野和快速的勘测速度，罗马将引领我们进入一个发现的新时代，让不可见的变得可见，为人类寻找太阳系以外的生命奠定基础。” 在任务的第一部分，罗曼使用近空网络与控制器进行通信，近空网络是一个由地面站和中继卫星组成的系统，负责处理跟踪、遥测和命令。发射后大约 70 分钟，通信转移到 NASA 的深空网络，这将有助于引导天文台前往距离地球约 100 万英里的第二个日地拉格朗日点（L2）。 L2 是一个区域，太阳和地球的引力影响使航天器能够在有限的燃料使用下保持相对稳定的位置。罗曼将首先通过澳大利亚的堪培拉深空通信中心进行通信。大约六个小时后，通讯将转移到...

reflection.en: The launch of the Roman Space Telescope marks a significant step in humanity's quest to understand the universe. As it embarks on its million-mile journey, it carries our collective curiosity to probe the mysteries of dark matter, dark energy, and exoplanets. This endeavor reminds us that the heavens themselves are a testament to a grandeur beyond our...
reflection.zh: 罗马空间望远镜的发射标志着人类探索宇宙奥秘的又一重要里程碑。它踏上了一百万英里的旅程，承载着我们集体的好奇心，去探究暗物质、暗能量和系外行星的奥秘。这项事业提醒我们，诸天本身就是宏伟壮丽的见证，超越我们目前的理解，激发着敬畏与惊叹。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Can you solve it? The fin-tastic fish puzzle
title.zh: 你能解开它吗？鱼的奇妙谜题

summary.en: This puzzle challenges readers to visualize and draw the top view of a fish's shortest path in a tank, based on its front and side views. It suggests consulting architects for help with 3D visualization and celebrates the opening of a new maths school.
summary.zh: 这个谜题挑战读者根据鱼在鱼缸中游动的正面和侧面视图，绘制出其最短路径的俯视图。它建议读者在三维可视化方面可以向建筑师寻求帮助，并庆祝一所新数学学校的开学。

body.en:
Today’s puzzle concerns a fish swimming in a tank that is two metres high, one metre across and one metre deep.

Today’s two puzzles present front and side views of fish paths. Can you draw the top view of the shortest path that produced these front and side views?

If you find visualising shapes in three-dimensions difficult, ask an architect for help. I have set similar puzzles twice before, in 2015 and in 2017 , and on both occasions architects wrote in to say they are trained to think in this way.

Today’s puzzles were created by maths educator George Watkins to celebrate the opening of the 1729 Maths School , which welcomes its first pupils later this month.

The school – in Mill Hill, north London – is the first specialist maths secondary school to open in the UK. Its name comes from a famous anecdote about a London taxi cab with the licence plate 1729 .

I’ve been setting a puzzle here on alternate Mondays since 2015. I’m always on the look-out for great puzzles. If you would like to suggest one, email me .
body.zh: 今天的难题涉及一条鱼在一个两米高、一米宽、一米深的水箱中游泳。 今天的两个谜题展示了鱼道的正面和侧面视图。你能画出产生这些前视图和侧视图的最短路径的俯视图吗？ 如果您发现在三维空间中可视化形状很困难，请向建筑师寻求帮助。我之前曾在 2015 年和 2017 年两次设置过类似的谜题，两次建筑师都写信说他们接受过以这种方式思考的训练。 今天的谜题是由数学教育家乔治·沃特金斯 (George Watkins) 创建的，旨在庆祝 1729 年数学学校的开学，该学校将于本月晚些时候迎来第一批学生。 这所学校位于伦敦北部的米尔山，是英国第一所开设的专业数学中学。它的名字来源于关于伦敦一辆牌照为1729的出租车的著名轶事。 自 2015 年以来，我一直在每隔一个星期一在这里设置一个谜题。我总是在寻找很棒的谜题。如果您想推荐一个，请给我发电子邮件。

reflection.en: This puzzle invites us to consider how different perspectives reveal different truths. Just as a fish's path can be understood from multiple angles, so too can we gain deeper understanding by observing the intricate designs in creation. The Bible encourages us to learn from the natural world, recognizing the wisdom embedded within it.
reflection.zh: 这个谜题邀请我们思考不同的视角如何揭示不同的真相。正如鱼的游动路径可以从多个角度来理解一样，我们也可以通过观察受造界错综复杂的设计来获得更深的理解。圣经鼓励我们从自然界学习，认识其中蕴含的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scale of snakebites estimated globally
title.zh: 蛇咬伤的规模估计全球

summary.en: A study published in Nature estimates the global incidence of snakebites and associated deaths using available data and modeling, providing crucial information for public health initiatives aimed at addressing this concern.
summary.zh: 发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究，利用现有数据和模型估计了全球蛇咬伤的发生率和相关死亡人数，为旨在解决这一问题的公共卫生举措提供了关键信息。

reflection.en: The vastness of the natural world, even its dangers like snakebites, holds lessons. By carefully studying patterns and using data, scientists can better understand and combat threats, reflecting the ancient wisdom that creation itself can teach us about its intricacies and how to navigate them.
reflection.zh: 即使是像蛇咬伤这样的危险，广阔的自然界也蕴含着教训。通过仔细研究模式和利用数据，科学家们可以更好地理解和对抗威胁，这反映了古老的智慧——造物本身可以教会我们关于其复杂性以及如何应对它们。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: What’s your lab’s archetype? The answer could inform how you use AI
title.zh: 你的实验室是什么原型？答案可能会影响你如何使用人工智能

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 31 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02543-z A white paper proposes four priority models for research groups, each with a distinct approach to utilizing artificial intelligence.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，2026年8月31日在线发表；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02543-z 一份白皮书为研究团队提出了四种优先模型，每种模型在利用人工智能方面都有不同的方法。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, its integration into scientific research presents new opportunities and challenges. This development echoes the ancient prophecy of knowledge increasing and understanding expanding, urging us to consider how we steward these powerful tools. May we pursue wisdom and discernment in applying these innovations,...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，其在科学研究中的应用带来了新的机遇和挑战。这一发展呼应了古老的预言，即知识增长，理解力扩展，促使我们思考如何管理这些强大的工具。愿我们在应用这些创新时，追求智慧和辨别力，确保它们服务于人类，并反映受造界的秩序。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Order from disorder: do we need a new law of physics?
title.zh: 秩序源于无序：我们是否需要新的物理定律？

summary.en: A radical proposal that evolutionary pressures apply to atoms as much as animals should provoke scientific debate.
summary.zh: 一项激进的提议认为，进化压力对原子的作用与对动物的作用一样大，这应该会引发科学辩论。

reflection.en: The universe, from the smallest atom to the grandest animal, reveals the intricate wisdom of its Creator. This proposal to explore evolutionary pressures on atoms invites us to see the deep order Yahweh has woven into the fabric of reality. May this scientific inquiry deepen our awe for the Creator's boundless ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 宇宙万物，从最小的原子到最宏伟的动物，都彰显了其创造者精妙的智慧。这项关于探索原子进化压力的提议，邀请我们看到雅伟编织在现实结构中的深层秩序。愿这项科学探索加深我们对创造者无限创造力的敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The leap second is dead. Long live the leap hour?
title.zh: 跳秒已死。跳时万岁？

summary.en: Fear of a possible ‘negative’ leap second is accelerating plans to abolish the practice.
summary.zh: 对可能出现的“负跳秒”的担忧正在加速废除该做法的计划。

reflection.en: The relentless march of human knowledge and technological innovation is a hallmark of our age. As we develop ever more sophisticated systems, like the precise timekeeping discussed here, we are reminded of the prophetic words that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This rapid advancement calls for wisdom and discernment, ensuring our...
reflection.zh: 人类知识和技术创新的不懈进步是我们这个时代的标志。随着我们开发出越来越复杂的系统，例如这里讨论的精确计时，我们不禁想起预言中的话：“许多人往来奔跑，知识就增长。”这种快速发展需要智慧和辨别力，以确保我们的创新能够服务于人类并反映受造界的秩序。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Why are rich people so pessimistic? What the numbers say
title.zh: 富人为何如此悲观？数字揭示原因

summary.en: A study published in Nature suggests that factors like age, location, and expectations significantly influence people's outlook on the future, with optimism appearing to be scarce in contemporary society.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志在线发表的一项研究表明，人们对未来的乐观程度很大程度上受到年龄、居住地和期望等因素的影响，在当今社会，乐观情绪似乎供不应求。

reflection.en: In a world where pessimism seems to be a growing trend, even among those with material wealth, it's easy to feel adrift. Yet, the ancient promise remains: 'For I know the plans I have for you,' declares Yahweh, 'plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.' This divine assurance offers a counterpoint to despair, reminding...
reflection.zh: 在一个悲观主义似乎日益成为趋势的世界里，即使在物质富裕的人群中也是如此，人们很容易感到迷失。然而，古老的应许依然存在：“雅伟说，‘我知道我为你们所定的计划，是使你们得平安，而不是灾祸的计划，要赐给你们盼望和未来。’”这神圣的保证是对绝望的有力回应，提醒我们，我们最终的盼望并非系于世俗的境况，而是系于雅伟永恒的信实。

verse.textEn: For I know the plans I have for you, declares Yahweh, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verse.textZh: 我知道我向你们所怀的意念，是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。这是雅伟说的。

title.en: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
title.zh: “巨大飞跃”：美国宇航局发射强大的新型太空望远镜

summary.en: NASA has launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a next-generation observatory designed to map the universe and investigate the mysteries of dark energy and dark matter. With a field of view 100 times larger than its predecessors, the mission will also search for exoplanets from its vantage point one million...
summary.zh: 美国宇航局（NASA）发射了南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜，这是一台旨在绘制宇宙地图并研究暗能量和暗物质奥秘的新一代天文台。该望远镜的视野比其前身大100倍，其任务还包括在距离地球100万英里的观测点搜寻系外行星。

body.en:
Nasa's powerful next-generation telescope has blasted off into space from its launchpad in Florida, with a mission to explore dark energy, black holes and other mysteries of the Universe.

The Nancy Grace Roman telescope will capture vast panoramic views of space, with a field of vision 100 times larger than both the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes, Nasa says.

The mission begins with a 100-day journey to a vantage point roughly one million miles from Earth, where the telescope will then start charting planets outside our solar system, known as exoplanets.

"Roman is going to change the way we look at the Universe," said Nicky Fox, a Nasa administrator.

The successful launch of the telescope took place on Sunday morning local time from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Jackie Townsend, a project manager on Nasa's Roman telescope, described it as "glorious" at a news conference afterwards. "The ride was magnificent. It put us right where we wanted to be."

About 30 minutes after launch, Roman separated from its SpaceX rocket and is now heading towards its orbiting point around a million miles away.

Fox said Roman "is going to discover tens of thousands, maybe even 100,000 new exoplanets" - referring to planets located outside of our solar system.

"Why do we care so much about exoplanets? Because one of our main goals at Nasa is answering the question, 'Are we alone in the universe'?" she added.

US President Donald Trump dialled in to the space agency's news conference to congratulate the scientists working on the project.

"You're the hottest in space, and we have the hottest country anywhere in the world. So, let's keep it all going. You're a big part of it," Trump said.

Astronomer Jenifer Millard said the telescope will be four times further from Earth than the Moon is, where a lot of infrared space cameras - made to pick up what she describes as "heat light"- operate.

She told the BBC this is to make sure infrared light from the Moon and Earth don't interfere with the cameras.

Nasa's James Webb Space Telescope, launched in 2021, also orbits the Sun around one million miles from Earth, but its field of vision is not as expansive. Nasa's Hubble Space Telescope, launched in 1990, orbits at about 300 miles above Earth's surface.

While Roman will look outward into the Universe, Millard said scientists are also anticipating it will find thousands of new worlds in our own galaxy.

The telescope is named after physicist Nancy Grace Roman, who was Nasa's first chief astronomer in the 1960s and its first female executive.

During her career, she was instrumental in getting the Hubble Space Telescope approved by US Congress and later said its most interesting discovery was dark energy.

The new telescope is similarly expected to...
body.zh: 美国宇航局强大的下一代望远镜已从佛罗里达州的发射台发射升空，其任务是探索暗能量、黑洞和宇宙的其他奥秘。 美国宇航局表示，南希·格雷斯·罗曼望远镜将捕捉广阔的太空全景，其视野比哈勃和詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜大100倍。 该任务从为期 100 天的旅程开始，到达距地球约 100 万英里的有利位置，然后望远镜将开始绘制太阳系外行星（称为系外行星）的图表。 “罗曼将改变我们看待宇宙的方式，”美国宇航局管理员尼基福克斯说。 该望远镜于当地时间周日上午在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心成功发射。 美国宇航局罗马望远镜的项目经理杰基·汤森德在随后的新闻发布会上形容这是“光荣的”。 “这次旅程非常棒。它让我们到达了我们想去的地方。” 发射后约 30 分钟，Roman 与 SpaceX 火箭分离，目前正朝着约 100 万英里外的轨道点前进。 福克斯表示，罗曼“将发现数万颗，甚至可能是 10 万颗新的系外行星”——指的是位于太阳系之外的行星。 “为什么我们如此关心系外行星？因为美国宇航局的主要目标之一就是回答这个问题：‘我们在宇宙中孤独吗？’”她补充道。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普拨通了航天局的新闻发布会，向从事该项目的科学家表示祝贺。 “你们是太空中最热门的国家，我们拥有世界上最热门的国家。所以，让我们继续努力。你们是其中的重要组成部分，”特朗普说。 天文学家詹妮弗·米勒德表示，这架望远镜距离地球的距离将是月球距离的四倍，月球上有许多红外太空相机，用于捕捉她所说的“热光”。 她告诉英国广播公司，这是为了确保来自月球和地球的红外光不会干扰相机。 美国宇航局 (NASA) 的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜于 2021 年发射，也绕太阳运行，距地球约 100 万英里，但其视野没有那么广阔。美国宇航局的哈勃太空望远镜于 1990 年发射，其轨道距地球表面约 300 英里。 米勒德表示，虽然罗曼将向外观察宇宙，但科学家们也预计它将在我们自己的星系中发现数千个新世界。 该望远镜以物理学家南希·格雷斯·罗曼 (Nancy Grace Roman) 的名字命名，她是 20 世纪 60 年代美国宇航局第一位首席天文学家，也是第一位女性高管。 在她的职业生涯中，她在哈勃太空望远镜获得美国国会批准方面发挥了重要作用，后来表示其最有趣的发现是暗能量。 新望远镜同样有望...

reflection.en: The launch of the Roman telescope reminds us that our curiosity is a response to a universe that seems designed to be discovered. As we peer into the mysteries of space with a field of vision 100 times wider than before, we find that the vastness does not diminish human significance but rather highlights the majesty of Yahweh. Each new map of the stars is a...
reflection.zh: 罗曼望远镜的发射提醒我们，人类的好奇心是对这个似乎注定要被发现的宇宙的一种回应。当我们以比以往宽100倍的视野窥探太空的奥秘时，我们发现这种浩瀚并没有削弱人类的意义，反而彰显了雅伟的雄伟。每一份新的星图都是宇宙故事中崭新的一页，不断宣告着远超我们自身的荣耀。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Charity thanks inmates for work to save hedgehogs
title.zh: 慈善机构感谢囚犯拯救刺猬的工作

summary.en: Prisoners at HMP La Moye are constructing feeding and nesting boxes for the Jersey Hedgehog Preservation Group using reclaimed timber. This initiative is praised for teaching inmates valuable carpentry skills, potentially reducing reoffending rates by equipping them for future employment and fostering a sense of...
summary.zh: 位于拉莫耶监狱（HMP La Moye）的囚犯正在利用回收的木材为泽西刺猬保护协会制作喂食箱和筑巢箱。这项倡议因教授囚犯宝贵的木工技能而受到赞扬，有可能通过为他们未来的就业做准备并培养社区贡献感来降低再犯率。

body.en:
An animal charity has thanked prison inmates for helping to save hedgehogs' lives.

Prisoners in HMP La Moye, in St Brelade, have given Jersey Hedgehog Preservation Group 20 feeding and nesting boxes which they have made out of reclaimed pallet timber.

Peter Gould, the prison's vocational manager, said the work could help reduce reoffending because it taught inmates skills to support future employment and helped them feel they were contributing to the community.

Dru Burdon, from the hedgehog group, said: "If it helps with carpentry skills training, so much the better, these boxes are certainly saving hedgehogs' lives."

Gould said the project also taught health and safety best practice and gave prisoners experience of using machinery and equipment.

"For some, the project provides a valuable introduction to skills that could lead to recognised qualifications and careers in the construction industry."

He said the project helped inmates have a "sense of purpose, achievement and connection to the community" which was "incredibly valuable".

Burdon said the scheme had developed from a chance meeting with a prison officer at the vets.

She said: "He found a little hedgehog in need of care and we got talking, so the upshot was that I gave them the templates for both nesting and feeding boxes."

She said of the 20 boxes the prisoners had given the charity earlier in August, all the feeding boxes had sold out and raised £20 each and there were just a few £25 nesting boxes left.

Gould said the hedgehog boxes formed part of a wider programme of vocational projects at the prison.

These included refurbishing bikes for donations to the Age Concern Jersey charity, restoring memorial benches , growing plants and vegetables for the prison kitchen and for charity, and helping create wildlife habitats.

"We're proud of the positive contribution prisoners can make through this work and pleased to see these projects being recognised," he added.

body.zh: 一家动物慈善机构感谢监狱囚犯帮助拯救刺猬的生命。 圣布雷拉德 HMP La Moye 的囚犯向泽西刺猬保护小组提供了 20 个用回收托盘木材制成的喂养箱和筑巢箱。 监狱职业经理彼得·古尔德表示，这项工作有助于减少再次犯罪，因为它教会了囚犯未来就业的技能，并帮助他们感觉自己正在为社区做出贡献。 刺猬小组的德鲁·伯登说：“如果这有助于木工技能培训，那就更好了，这些盒子肯定能拯救刺猬的生命。” 古尔德说，该项目还教授健康和安全最佳实践，并为囚犯提供使用机械和设备的经验。 “对于一些人来说，该项目提供了宝贵的技能介绍，可以帮助他们获得建筑行业认可的资格和职业。” 他说，该项目帮助囚犯产生“使命感、成就感以及与社区的联系”，这是“非常有价值的”。 伯登说，这个计划是在一次与兽医监狱官员的偶然会面中制定的。 她说：“他发现一只需要照顾的小刺猬，我们进行了交谈，所以结果是我给了他们筑巢和饲养箱的模板。” 她说，囚犯们在八月初向慈善机构捐赠了 20 个盒子，其中所有喂食盒都已售罄，每个盒子筹集了 20 英镑，只剩下几个 25 英镑的巢箱。 古尔德说，刺猬盒子是监狱更广泛的职业项目计划的一部分。 其中包括翻新自行车以向 Age Concern Jersey 慈善机构捐款、修复纪念长凳、为监狱厨房和慈善机构种植植物和蔬菜，以及帮助创建野生动物栖息地。 他补充说：“我们为囚犯通过这项工作做出的积极贡献感到自豪，并很高兴看到这些项目得到认可。” 在 X（外部）和 Facebook（外部）上关注 BBC Jersey。将您的故事创意发送至外部的channel.islands@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: In a remarkable act of rehabilitation and conservation, prisoners at HMP La Moye are channeling their efforts into crafting essential nesting and feeding boxes for hedgehogs. This project not only aids a vulnerable species but also equips the inmates with practical skills, offering them a pathway toward future employment and a renewed sense of purpose...
reflection.zh: 在感化和保育方面的一项了不起的举措中，拉莫耶监狱的囚犯正致力于为刺猬制作重要的筑巢箱和喂食箱。这个项目不仅帮助了一个脆弱的物种，也为囚犯提供了实用的技能，为他们未来的就业铺平了道路，并培养了他们对社区的价值感和新的目标感。这是一个有力的提醒，即使在充满挑战的环境中，有意义的工作也能促进治愈和希望。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Nature reserves spot rare species during heatwaves
title.zh: 高温天气和监测增加促使自然保护区发现稀有物种

summary.en: A wildlife trust has reported that unusually hot weather combined with increased monitoring efforts has led to the discovery of several rare species in nature reserves this summer, some not seen for many years.
summary.zh: 一个野生动物信托基金会报告称，今年夏天，异常炎热的天气加上加强的监测工作，使得自然保护区内发现了多种稀有物种，其中一些物种已多年未见。

body.en:
A wildlife trust said some species had been spotted in nature reserves this summer for the first time in years.

Volunteers for the Herts and Middlesex Wildlife Trust recorded a great white egret near Ware and more than 300 Chalkhill blue butterflies at Hexton Chalk Pit near Hitchin, where they also found a glow-worm for the first time in 25 years.

The trust said it was partly due to the unusually hot weather but also the result of increased surveying and monitoring in the county.

Senior reserves officer Dan Townsend said: "This summer we've had some extraordinary records, from species that haven't been recorded in Hertfordshire for decades to new discoveries for individual reserves."

The St Albans-based trust manages more than 40 nature reserves covering nearly 810 hectares (2,000 acres) in Hertfordshire and Middlesex.

It said grasshoppers had flourished during the hot summer, while butterflies had been able to complete their life cycle more quickly and emerge in large numbers.

Its reserves have provided the setting for several significant discoveries by the Herts Invertebrate Project , external , which was set up in 2015.

At the end of June, the project visited Fir & Pond Woods, near Potters Bar, and recorded Euides basilinea, a planthopper associated with reeds, which had no previous records in Hertfordshire.

At Aldbury Nowers, near Tring, the leafhopper Zygina hyperici was recorded for the first time in the county since 1916.

Arboridia parvula, a leafhopper associated with Common Rockrose, was also recorded for the first time in Hertfordshire since 1976. The survey also uncovered Agyneta mollis, a tiny nationally rare money spider.

Jersey Tiger moths, once more strongly associated with the Channel Islands, have increasingly been recorded further north, while Hummingbird Hawk-moths are also being seen regularly in Hertfordshire.

Townsend said: "These discoveries help us understand which species are present, where they are found and how they are responding to changes in their environment.

"That knowledge is essential for informing the management of our nature reserves effectively and giving wildlife the opportunity to thrive."

Follow Beds, Herts and Bucks news on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , Instagram , external and X , external .
body.zh: 野生动物信托基金表示，今年夏天，多年来首次在自然保护区发现了一些物种。 赫茨和米德尔塞克斯野生动物基金会的志愿者在韦尔附近记录了一只大白鹭，在希钦附近的赫克斯顿粉笔坑记录了 300 多只查克希尔蓝蝴蝶，他们还在那里发现了 25 年来的首次萤火虫。 该信托基金表示，部分原因是异常炎热的天气，但也是该县加强调查和监测的结果。 高级保护区官员丹·汤森德（Dan Townsend）说：“今年夏天，我们取得了一些非凡的记录，从赫特福德郡几十年来没有记录的物种到个别保护区的新发现。” 这家总部位于圣奥尔本斯的信托基金管理着赫特福德郡和米德尔塞克斯郡的 40 多个自然保护区，占地近 810 公顷（2,000 英亩）。 报告称，蝗虫在炎热的夏季繁衍生息，而蝴蝶则能够更快地完成生命周期并大量涌现。 其储量为 2015 年设立的外部赫茨无脊椎动物项目的多项重大发现奠定了基础。 6月底，该项目访问了Potters Bar附近的Fir & Pond Woods，记录了一种与芦苇有关的飞虱Euides basilinea，该种飞虱在赫特福德郡以前没有记录。 在特林附近的奥尔德伯里诺尔斯 (Aldbury Nowers)，自 1916 年以来首次在该县记录到叶蝉 Zygina hyperici。 自 1976 年以来，赫特福德郡首次记录到与常见岩玫瑰相关的叶蝉 Arboridia parvula。调查还发现了 Agyneta mollis，一种全国罕见的小型金钱蜘蛛。 泽西虎蛾再次与海峡群岛密切相关，越来越多地在更北的地方出现，而蜂鸟鹰蛾也经常出现在赫特福德郡。 汤森德说：“这些发现帮助我们了解存在哪些物种、在哪里发现它们以及它们如何应对环境的变化。 “这些知识对于有效地管理我们的自然保护区并为野生动物提供繁衍生息的机会至关重要。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注 Beds、Herts 和 Bucks 的新闻。

reflection.en: The Herts and Middlesex Wildlife Trust's summer discoveries, like the great white egret and glow-worm, are a testament to the intricate wonders of creation. Even in challenging conditions like heatwaves, the natural world continues to reveal its marvels, pointing to the profound wisdom of its Maker. These sightings remind us that Yahweh's presence and...
reflection.zh: 赫特福德郡和米德尔塞克斯野生动物信托基金会夏季的发现，如大白鹭和萤火虫，证明了造物之工的精妙奇迹。即使在热浪等严峻条件下，大自然也持续展现其奇迹，指向其创造者的深邃智慧。这些目击事件提醒我们，雅伟的临在和设计在地球上最微小、最出乎意料的角落里都显而易见。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Australia usually hosts the world's biggest cuttlefish mating event - not this year
title.zh: 澳大利亚通常是世界上最大的乌贼交配活动的主办地——今年却不是

summary.en: Official figures show only 1,811 cuttlefish appeared for mating this year, a staggering 97% decrease from the previous year, raising alarms about a potential "catastrophic decline" of the species.
summary.zh: 官方数据显示，今年只有 1,811 只乌贼前来交配，比去年锐减了 97%，引发了对该物种可能“灾难性下降”的担忧。

body.en:
Every winter, a sliver of the South Australian coast hosts the world's largest mating event for giant cuttlefish.

Some years, hundreds of thousands of the unique marine species endemic to Australia gather along the Cuttlefish Coast for the annual mating season, bringing their colourful, shape-shifting figures to the shallow waters and attracting thousands of keen divers.

But this year, the turnout was the lowest on record, sparking concerns of a "catastrophic decline" of the species.

Official figures released this month estimate just 1,811 cuttlefish turned up to mate this year, down from 63,000 last year - a 97% drop.

The state government says a toxic algal bloom that has ravaged the state's coastline for more than 18 months may be to blame for the sharp decline.

The low figures have also prompted calls for the species to be listed as endangered.

Adult cuttlefish typically die after breeding so each mating season is crucial for the species' future, but in recent months, just 440 eggs have been counted, instead of the millions that are usually laid.

Manny Katz, 28, was one of four divers who spent hours along the coast last month to observe the annual breeding event, having been tasked by South Australia's Department of Environment and Water (DEW).

"Because there have been so few cuttlefish, DEW thought it would be worth going out and trying to do an assessment of how many eggs there currently are around the coastline to understand what the population is going to be next year."

Over two days in July, his team did eight one-hour dives, exploring the undersides of rocky reefs to count the eggs.

"Along the eight kilometres (five miles) of coastline, there would normally be millions of eggs," he said, as each female can lay dozens of egg and tens of thousands usually turn up to breed.

"[We] pretty much looked under every single rock that we could have and we only found about 440 eggs."

Crucially, adult cuttlefish only live about 12 to 18 months, Katz said, "so the success of one breeding season is going to determine the population next year".

"Under our current circumstances, with there being so few eggs along the coastline, we don't know if the population is ever going to be able to recover."

While it's too early to tell what this means for the species' future, Katz said: "we will know that answer probably in the next year or two, whether or not this year has been a catastrophic decline."

His team also tracked adult cuttlefish numbers during the dive survey, and said the dozen or so they saw - when there should have been tens of thousands - appeared to be behaving differently.

"This year, they were all really skittish... hiding under rocks. Because there's so few cuttlefish hanging out at the moment, they don't have strength in...
body.zh: 每年冬天，南澳大利亚海岸的一小片地区都会举办世界上最大的巨型乌贼交配活动。 有时候，数十万种澳大利亚特有的独特海洋物种聚集在墨鱼海岸度过一年一度的交配季节，将它们色彩缤纷、变形的形象带到浅水区，吸引了成千上万的热衷潜水者。 但今年的投票率是有记录以来最低的，引发了对该物种“灾难性衰退”的担忧。 本月发布的官方数据估计，今年只有 1,811 只乌贼进行交配，比去年的 63,000 只减少了 97%。 州政府表示，有毒藻华已经肆虐该州海岸线18个多月，可能是造成数量急剧下降的原因。 较低的数字也促使人们呼吁将该物种列为濒危物种。 成年墨鱼通常在繁殖后死亡，因此每个交配季节对于该物种的未来至关重要，但最近几个月，仅统计了 440 枚卵，而不是通常产下的数百万枚。 28 岁的曼尼·卡茨 (Manny Katz) 是上个月受南澳大利亚环境与水务部 (DEW) 委托，在海岸花费数小时观察一年一度的繁殖活动的四名潜水员之一。 “由于墨鱼数量太少，DEW 认为值得出去尝试评估目前海岸线周围有多少墨鱼卵，以了解明年的墨鱼数量。” 七月的两天里，他的团队进行了八次一小时的潜水，探索岩礁的底部来数卵。 “沿着八公里（五英里）的海岸线，通常会有数百万个卵，”他说，因为每个雌性可以产下数十个卵，并且通常有数以万计的卵来繁殖。 “[我们]几乎检查了我们能找到的每一块岩石，只发现了大约 440 个鸡蛋。” 卡茨说，最重要的是，成年乌贼的寿命约为 12 至 18 个月，“因此一个繁殖季节的成功将决定明年的种群数量”。 “在我们目前的情况下，由于海岸线上的鸡蛋很少，我们不知道种群数量是否能够恢复。” 虽然现在判断这对该物种的未来意味着什么还为时过早，但卡茨说：“我们可能会在未来一两年内知道答案，无论今年是否出现了灾难性的下降。” 他的团队还在潜水调查期间追踪了成年乌贼的数量，并表示他们看到的十几只乌贼——原本应该有数万只——似乎表现不同。 “今年，它们都很胆怯……躲在岩石下面。因为现在闲逛的墨鱼太少了，它们没有力气……

reflection.en: The "Cuttlefish Coast" in South Australia usually teems with hundreds of thousands of giant cuttlefish for their annual mating. This year, a mere 1,811 appeared, a devastating 97% drop. This stark decline in a unique species is a somber reminder of the intricate web of life and the fragility of creation's wonders. Yahweh's creation is vast and filled with...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚的“乌贼海岸”通常在每年繁殖季节吸引数十万只巨型乌贼。今年却只有区区 1,811 只出现，数量锐减了 97%，这是一个令人痛心的消息。这种独特物种的急剧减少，是对生命复杂网络和造物之奇妙脆弱性的一个严肃提醒。 雅伟的创造浩瀚无垠，充满了奇迹，从最小的生物到最宏伟的生态系统。当这宝贵的生物多样性中如此重要的一部分 falter...

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.zh: 阻止英格兰缺水的竞赛

summary.en: Who is to blame for the summer drought, and can England future-proof its water supplies? It was from his local water board and it read: "River levels are low but have recovered enough to allow one night of irrigation tonight." Like much of the lower half of England, Daniel's fourth-generation farm had seen barely any...
summary.zh: 夏季干旱该怪谁，英格兰能否为供水做好未来准备？ 他收到了当地水务局的通知，上面写着：“河流水位低，但已恢复到足以允许今晚灌溉一次。” 与英格兰下半部的大部分地区一样，丹尼尔的第四代农场近三个月几乎没下过雨。 他向我们展示了他在萨福克郡 300 公顷的农场里剩下的豌豆和小麦作物。...

body.en:
It was from his local water board and it read: "River levels are low but have recovered enough to allow one night of irrigation tonight."

Like much of the lower half of England, Daniel's fourth-generation farm had seen barely any rain in nearly three months.

He shows us what is left of the peas and wheat crop at his 300-hectare site in Suffolk.

"There's no water in the river so half my crop is completely and utterly ruined."

With river levels falling so low that taking any more water out of them risked endangering wildlife, in July the Environment Agency (EA) temporarily stopped Daniel and thousands of other farmers from watering their crops from the river.

The kind of increasingly frequent heatwaves we have experienced and greatly reduced rainfall that we could see over successive summers with climate change, plus a projected increase in demand for water, have raised the prospect that England could at some point run out of water.

The result could be that by 2055 England will face a shortfall of five billion litres in public water supply a day, almost enough to fill Wembley Stadium four and a half times daily. A mixture of low rainfall, high temperatures and demand put pressure on water supply in England more so than elsewhere in the UK.

It is all a far cry from when, in 1818, John Keats wrote: "It is impossible to live in a country which is continually under hatches… Rain! Rain! Rain!"

But what is really to blame for England finding its water supply so under threat? And are there ways of securing its future?

Back in the 1980s, people in England and Denmark were using water at a similar rate. But no longer.

Residents in Denmark now consume 97 litres of water per person per day, according to Danva, the country's water and wastewater industry body. The daily consumption per person in England is 136.5 litres.

"We've actually doubled the amount of water we use per person, on average, in the last 50, 60 years," points out Nicci Russell, who runs Waterwise, a water efficiency campaign organisation.

She points to changing habits over generations - from a family having a shared bath once a week to having multiple showers a week, sometimes a day.

Households are responsible for nearly 60% of water use in England and Wales. If we had domestic water consumption patterns more like Denmark, Russell says, more than half the 2055 shortfall would be wiped out.

Russell says, even with projected population growth, if everyone in England knocked a minute off their shower time, for example, it would save nearly one billion litres of water a day by 2050.

But water companies have been running campaigns urging us to use less water, seemingly with limited success.

Will Willoughby, director of water supply at Wessex Water, acknowledges that the negative...
body.zh: 这是他当地水务局发来的，上面写着：“河流水位很低，但已经恢复到今晚可以进行一晚的灌溉。” 与英格兰下半部的大部分地区一样，丹尼尔的第四代农场在近三个月内几乎没有下过雨。 他向我们展示了他位于萨福克郡 300 公顷土地上剩余的豌豆和小麦作物。 “河里没有水了，所以我一半的庄稼都彻底毁了。” 由于河流水位下降得如此之低，以至于从河流中抽取更多的水可能会危及野生动物，环境局 (EA) 7 月份暂时阻止了丹尼尔和其他数千名农民从河里浇灌农作物。 我们经历的越来越频繁的热浪，以及气候变化导致连续几个夏季的降雨量大幅减少，加上预计对水的需求增加，都增加了英格兰可能在某个时候耗尽水资源的可能性。 其结果可能是，到 2055 年，英格兰每天将面临 50 亿升公共供水短缺，几乎足以满足温布利体育场每天四次半的用水量。降雨量少、气温高和需求旺盛，给英格兰的供水带来的压力比英国其他地方更大。 这一切与 1818 年约翰·济慈 (John Keats) 写道：“生活在一个不断处于孵化状态的国家是不可能的……下雨！下雨！下雨！” 但英国发现其供水受到如此严重的威胁，真正的罪魁祸首是什么？有没有办法确保其未来？ 早在 20 世纪 80 年代，英格兰和丹麦的用水率就相似。但不再是了。 据丹麦水和废水处理行业机构 Danva 称，目前丹麦居民每人每天消耗 97 升水。英国人均每日消费量为136.5升。 “在过去 50、60 年里，我们的人均用水量实际上增加了一倍，”用水效率运动组织 Waterwise 的负责人尼奇·拉塞尔 (Nicci Russell) 指出。 她指出，几代人以来习惯的改变——从一个家庭每周一次共用浴室到每周多次淋浴，有时甚至是一天。 在英格兰和威尔士，家庭用水量占近 60%。拉塞尔说，如果我们的生活用水模式更像丹麦，那么到 2055 年，一半以上的缺口将被消除。 拉塞尔表示，即使人口预计增长，如果英格兰每个人都减少一分钟的淋浴时间，到 2050 年每天将节省近 10 亿升水。 但自来水公司一直在开展活动，敦促我们减少用水，但似乎收效甚微。 威塞克斯水务公司 (Wessex Water) 供水总监威尔·威洛比 (Will Willoughby) 承认，负面影响...

reflection.en: The prolonged drought in England has brought the vital resource of water to a critical point, impacting agriculture and the natural environment. This situation prompts reflection on the intricate systems of creation and the wisdom inherent in its design, as Psalm 104:24 reminds us of the abundance and variety Yahweh has made. As Daniel's farm faces ruin due...
reflection.zh: 英格兰持续的干旱使宝贵的水资源达到了危急关头，影响了农业和自然环境。这种情况促使我们反思受造界的复杂系统及其固有的智慧，正如诗篇 104:24 所提醒我们的，雅伟所造的万物丰盛而多样。...

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。
