title.en: Amazon rigged billions in ad pricing, lawsuit from states and US watchdog alleges
title.zh: 亚马逊被指控操纵广告定价，面临美国各州和监管机构的诉讼

summary.en: Amazon is facing a lawsuit from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and 22 states, which alleges the company secretly overcharged over a million advertising customers by manipulating online auction prices since 2019, potentially netting $20 billion. Amazon disputes these claims, stating the FTC misunderstands their ad...
summary.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）和22个州联合对亚马逊提起诉讼，指控该公司自2019年以来通过操纵在线拍卖价格，秘密向超过一百万的广告客户收取过高费用，可能已获利200亿美元。亚马逊对此表示强烈反对，认为FTC误解了其广告市场。

body.en:
The US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and a bipartisan group of 22 states has filed a lawsuit alleging Amazon secretly overcharged more than a million advertising customers by manipulating online auctions it uses to set ad prices.

The FTC and states say in their lawsuit filed Monday that the alleged scheme has likely netted the company $20bn from advertising customers since 2019.

"Amazon overrides and replaces the actual auction results with higher prices set by Amazon to increase its profits," says a complaint filed in the company's home state of Washington.

In a statement to the BBC, Amazon "strongly disagrees" with the premise that it misled advertisers and called the suit "misguided."

In addition to advertisers, the FTC, a US consumer watchdog, and the states say Amazon customers have also been harmed as extra costs are passed onto shoppers.

"Consumers are suffering, have suffered, and will continue to suffer substantial injury as a result," the complaint states, prompting swift pushback from Amazon.

"The FTC wants the public to believe this case is about higher prices for consumers. It is not," Amazon said in its statement.

The company's shares fell following the announcement of the lawsuit, closing 2.5% lower on Monday.

Many brands and sellers compete on Amazon to place Sponsored Product ads and Sponsored Brands ads when consumer search for products using keywords on Amazon's e-commerce platform.

The complaint accuses Amazon of secretly charging advertisers more in so-called "second price" auctions, whereby prospective advertisers expect to pay one cent more than the next highest bidder for each bid they win.

But in practice, the complaint alleges, Amazon has charged its Sponsored Products advertisers their own winning bid close to 80% of the time.

The lawsuit states that Amazon's methods were spurred because "it was unhappy about how much revenue its advertising auctions were generating".

Amazon responded by saying the FTC "fundamentally misunderstands how advertisers operate".

"Advertisers adjust bids based on real-world performance, not descriptions of auction mechanics," Amazon said in its statement.

"Average winning bids fell 50% from 2019 to 2025 on Sponsored Products search ads, and roughly 92% of placed ads are not given to the highest bid," the company added.

Last year, it settled a case with the FTC that alleged that it enrolled millions of consumers in its Prime subscription offering without their consent, and knowingly made it difficult for consumers to cancel.

Amazon settled the case for $2.5bn, including civil penalties and consumer refunds.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和一个由 22 个州组成的两党组织已提起诉讼，指控亚马逊通过操纵用于设定广告价格的在线拍卖，秘密向超过 100 万广告客户收取过高费用。 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和各州在周一提起的诉讼中表示，自 2019 年以来，涉嫌的计划可能已使该公司从广告客户中获利 200 亿美元。 在该公司总部华盛顿州提交的一份投诉称，“亚马逊为了增加利润而设定了更高的价格，从而推翻并取代了实际的拍卖结果。” 在给 BBC 的一份声明中，亚马逊“强烈不同意”其误导广告商的前提，并称该诉讼“具有误导性”。 除了广告商之外，美国消费者监管机构联邦贸易委员会和各州表示，由于额外成本转嫁给购物者，亚马逊的客户也受到了伤害。 投诉称：“消费者正在遭受、已经遭受并将继续遭受重大伤害。”这引发了亚马逊的迅速反击。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“联邦贸易委员会希望公众相信此案是为了向消费者收取更高的价格。但事实并非如此。” 诉讼公告公布后，该公司股价下跌，周一收盘下跌 2.5%。 当消费者在亚马逊电子商务平台上使用关键字搜索产品时，许多品牌和卖家都在亚马逊上竞争投放商品推广广告和品牌推广广告。 起诉书指控亚马逊在所谓的“第二价格”拍卖中秘密向广告商收取更高费用，即潜在的广告商希望为他们每次获胜的出价比第二高出价者多支付一美分。 但在实践中，投诉称，近 80% 的情况下，亚马逊都会向其商品推广广告商收取自己的中标费用。 该诉讼称，亚马逊的做法之所以受到刺激，是因为“它对其广告拍卖产生的收入感到不满”。 亚马逊回应称，联邦贸易委员会“从根本上误解了广告商的运作方式”。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“广告商根据现实世界的表现调整出价，而不是根据拍卖机制的描述。” 该公司补充道：“从 2019 年到 2025 年，商品推广搜索广告的平均中标出价下降了 50%，大约 92% 的投放广告没有给出最高出价。” 去年，该公司与美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 达成和解，指控该公司在未经数百万消费者同意的情况下将其纳入其 Prime 订阅服务，并故意让消费者难以取消。 亚马逊以 25 亿美元和解，包括民事罚款和消费者退款。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: This lawsuit highlights the tension between corporate profit and fair practice. The allegations suggest a deliberate manipulation of pricing, raising questions about accountability and justice in the digital marketplace. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide all economic interactions.
reflection.zh: 这项诉讼凸显了企业利润与公平交易之间的紧张关系。这些指控暗示了故意的价格操纵，引发了对数字市场中问责制和公正性的疑问。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的神同行，这些原则应指导所有经济往来。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Review: Coyote vs. Acme is an unabashed love letter to Looney Tunes
title.zh: 评论：兔八哥大战二丁目是献给乐一通的毫不掩饰的情书

summary.en: Director Dave Green's live action/animated hybrid captures the smart, subversive weirdness of the classic cartoons. After a three-year delay, 'Coyote vs. Acme' is finally in theaters, delighting audiences with its blend of slapstick, satire, and warmth, proving worth the wait.
summary.zh: 导演戴夫·格林的真人与动画结合的影片捕捉到了经典卡通片聪明、颠覆性的怪诞风格。经过三年的延误，《兔八哥大战二丁目》终于上映，以其融合了滑稽、讽刺和温情的风格取悦了观众，证明了等待是值得的。

body.en: It took three years, but Coyote vs. Acme is finally in theaters and delighting audiences of all ages with its irresistible blend of slapstick humor, pointed satire, and even a warm fuzzy here and there. We're happy to report that the film was worth the wait. (Some spoilers below but no major reveals.) The film is based on a well-known satirical piece by Ian Frazier (also titled “Coyote vs. Acme”) published in The New Yorker in 1990. Development of a film version didn’t start until 2018, but some pretty talented people worked on the script, including James Gunn. Small wonder that Warner Bros.’ bizarre 2023 decision to shelve the film in order to take a tax write-off sparked outrage both within the industry and among fans online. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 历时三年，《土狼大战阿克米》终于在影院上映，以其令人难以抗拒的滑稽幽默、尖刻讽刺，甚至时不时出现的温暖模糊的融合，让各个年龄段的观众都感到高兴。我们很高兴地告诉大家，这部电影值得等待。 （下面有一些剧透，但没有重大透露。）这部电影改编自伊恩·弗雷泽 (Ian Frazier) 1990 年在《纽约客》上发表的著名讽刺文章（也名为《Coyote vs. Acme》）。电影版本的开发直到 2018 年才开始，但一些非常有才华的人参与了剧本创作，其中包括詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn)。难怪华纳兄弟在 2023 年做出了搁置这部电影以进行税务冲销的奇怪决定，此举引发了业内和网上粉丝的愤怒。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The creation of 'Coyote vs. Acme,' a film that captures the unique spirit of Looney Tunes, speaks to the explosion of human creativity and knowledge. Daniel 12:4 foretells a time when 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This film, born from years of work and a blend of artistic talents, is a testament to that increasing knowledge and...
reflection.zh: 《兔八哥大战二丁目》这部影片捕捉了乐一通独特的精神，它的创作体现了人类创造力和知识的爆发。但以理书12:4预言：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”这部影片历经多年打磨，汇集了众多艺术人才，正是这种日益增长的知识及其富有想象力的表达方式的证明。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Trump tells FCC to punish journalist for calling his election results "mixed"
title.zh: 特朗普要求FCC惩罚记者，因其称其选举结果“好坏参半”

summary.en: President Trump has called for the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to punish or rebuke NBC journalist Kristen Welker for stating that his primary election endorsements had "mixed results." Trump accused Welker of "purposeful inaccuracy" and used the incident to criticize the 'Meet the Press' program.
summary.zh: 特朗普总统要求联邦通信委员会（FCC）惩罚或谴责NBC记者克里斯汀·威尔克，因为她称其在初选中的背书“好坏参半”。特朗普指责威尔克“故意不准确”，并以此批评“与人民面对面”节目。

body.en: President Trump yesterday demanded that the Federal Communications Commission punish or rebuke an NBC journalist for saying he has "mixed results" in his election endorsements. In the latest example of how Trump is using the FCC to harass reporters and news organizations that he dislikes, he said Meet the Press host Kristen Welker "will be reported to the FCC for rebuke or punishment" for what he claimed was a "purposeful inaccuracy." "Kristen Welker, the Unpopular 'Hostess' of the once great Meet the Press, now considered Meet the Fake Press, just stated that Donald Trump has 'mixed results' on his Endorsements of Candidates, when the recent WINS of Darline Graham and Mike Mazzei, stand at 100% for the U.S. Senate, and 98% for the U.S. House, recently and over the longterm. How can anyone be allowed to say this, working for freely given Public Airwaves? Results are attached. Because of this purposeful inaccuracy, she will be reported to the FCC for rebuke or punishment," Trump wrote in a Truth Social post . A separate post from Trump yesterday said, "THE FAKE POLLS USED BY OUR CROOKED MEDIA ARE OUT OF CONTROL, AND SOMETHING MUST BE DONE ABOUT IT. FCC TO THE RESCUE! President DJT." Trump also posted a rant on Friday about New York Times journalist Maggie Haberman, calling her "an unattractive person both inside and out" who "should be forced to turn over any and all money that she’s made through her fake reporting on me." Trump referred to Haberman throughout his post as "Maggot Haberman." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 特朗普总统昨天要求联邦通信委员会惩罚或斥责一名 NBC 记者，因为该记者称他在选举支持中“结果好坏参半”。在特朗普如何利用联邦通信委员会骚扰他不喜欢的记者和新闻机构的最新例子中，他表示，《会见新闻界》主持人克里斯汀·韦尔克“将因他声称的“故意失实”而向联邦通信委员会报告，接受谴责或惩罚。 “曾经伟大的《与媒体会面》节目中不受欢迎的‘女主人’克里斯汀·维尔克，现在被认为是‘与假媒体会面’，她刚刚表示，唐纳德·特朗普对候选人的支持“结果好坏参半”，而最近达林·格雷厄姆和迈克·马泽伊在美国参议院的支持率为 100%，在美国众议院的支持率为 100%，无论是近期还是长期来看。谁能允许说呢？特朗普在《真相社会》的帖子中写道，由于这种故意的不准确行为，她将被报告给联邦通信委员会以接受谴责或惩罚。特朗普昨天在另一篇帖子中表示，“我们不诚实的媒体使用的虚假民意调查已经失控，必须对此采取措施。FCC 来救援！DJT 总统。”特朗普周五还对《纽约时报》记者玛吉·哈伯曼进行了咆哮，称她“是一个从里到外都没有吸引力的人”，“应该被迫交出她通过虚假报道我赚到的所有钱”。特朗普在整个帖子中称哈伯曼为“蛆哈伯曼”。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of building up or tearing down. When spoken by those in positions of authority, their impact is amplified, potentially silencing dissent or punishing perceived inaccuracies. The story of President Trump's demand to the FCC serves as a stark reminder of the need for careful speech and the potential for words to be...
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能建造也能摧毁。当权者说出的话语，其影响力会被放大，可能压制异议或惩罚被视为不准确的言论。特朗普总统要求联邦通信委员会采取行动的故事，鲜明地提醒我们言语需谨慎，以及言语可能被武器化的危险。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: “Zlibrary my beloved”: Anthropic staff chats extolling piracy cited in Sony suit
title.zh: “我心爱的Zlibrary”：Anthropic员工吹捧盗版言论被索尼诉讼引用

summary.en: A lawsuit claims that Anthropic's alleged use of pirated books and music to train its AI models, despite a prior $1.5 billion settlement, has harmed songwriters and led to AI-generated songs topping charts.
summary.zh: 一项诉讼声称，Anthropic公司在先前支付了15亿美元和解金后，仍涉嫌使用盗版书籍和音乐来训练其人工智能模型，此举损害了词曲作者的利益，并导致人工智能生成的歌曲登上排行榜。

body.en: Some of the world’s leading music publishers think that Anthropic got off too light in a historic settlement where the Claude maker paid authors $1.5 billion after admitting to pirating more than 7 million books to train AI. “$1.5 billion is obviously not a large enough settlement to deter infringing conduct by a company that has parlayed such mass infringement into a staggering $2-trillion-dollar valuation,” music publishers said in a lawsuit filed Friday. Music publishers suing Anthropic include Sony, EMI, and Warner Chappell. They alleged that Anthropic’s illegal torrenting also included “thousands upon thousands” of their copyrighted musical compositions. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一些世界领先的音乐出版商认为，在一项历史性和解中，Anthropic 的表现太轻了。克劳德的制作者在承认盗版超过 700 万本书来训练人工智能后，向作者支付了 15 亿美元。音乐出版商在周五提起的诉讼中表示，“15 亿美元的和解金额显然不足以阻止一家公司的侵权行为，该公司已将如此大规模的侵权行为转化为惊人的 2 万亿美元估值。”起诉 Anthropic 的音乐出版商包括索尼、百代和华纳查普尔。他们声称 Anthropic 的非法洪流还包括“成千上万”他们受版权保护的音乐作品。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge and technological advancement, while valuable, can become a source of arrogance when it disregards the rights and contributions of others. The Bible warns that 'knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.' True progress requires not just intellectual prowess but also a foundation of love, respect, and ethical consideration for all...
reflection.zh: 追求知识和技术进步固然有价值，但当它忽视他人的权利和贡献时，就可能滋生骄傲。《圣经》警告说：“知识会使人自高自大，唯有爱心能造就人。”真正的进步不仅需要智慧，更需要以爱心、尊重和道德考量为基础，关怀所有创作者。

verse.textEn: Knowledge puffs up while love builds up.
verse.textZh: 知识是叫人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。

title.en: Trump attacks datacenter backlash, claiming communities pushing back risk becoming ‘backwards and poor’
title.zh: 特朗普称数据中心反对者“想变得落后而贫穷”

summary.en: Donald Trump has criticized communities pushing back against datacenter projects across the US, warning that those that reject them risk becoming “backwards and poor.” This comes amid a growing backlash against such projects, with a recent poll showing three-quarters of Americans oppose datacenters being built near...
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普批评了美国各地反对数据中心项目的社区，警告那些拒绝这些项目的社区将面临“落后和贫穷”的风险。此前，公众对这类项目的不满情绪日益增长，一项最新民意调查显示，四分之三的美国人反对在家附近建造数据中心。围绕这些数据中心的争议正席卷全国各地的竞选活动，为即将到来的十一月中期选举增添了新的话题。

body.en: Three-quarters of Americans said in a recent poll that they oppose datacenters being built next to their homes Donald Trump has criticized communities pushing back against datacenter projects across the US amid a growing backlash, warning those that reject them risk becoming “backwards and poor”. As controversy surrounding local datacenter plans continues to swirl around election campaigns nationwide ahead of November’s midterm elections, the US president declared Americans “will only have yourselves to blame” if they are canceled. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在最近的一项民意调查中，四分之三的美国人表示，他们反对在自己家旁边建造数据中心。唐纳德·特朗普批评美国各地社区抵制数据中心项目的呼声越来越高，并警​​告那些拒绝这些项目的人可能会变得“落后和贫穷”。在 11 月中期选举之前，围绕当地数据中心计划的争议继续围绕全国范围内的竞选活动展开，美国总统宣称，如果这些计划被取消，美国人“只能怪自己”。继续阅读...

Proverbs 14:34 suggests that righteousness elevates a nation, while sin is a disgrace. This raises questions about how communities and leaders weigh economic development against local concerns and environmental...
reflection.zh: 发展数据中心等技术进步的追求，常常引发关于地方影响与国家进步之间权衡的辩论。《箴言》14:34指出，公义使邦国高升，罪恶是人民的羞辱。这引发了关于社区和领导者如何平衡经济发展与地方关切及环境影响的问题，以寻求真正惠及所有人的道路。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Raindrops are tiny lightning bolts, and they’re corroding cars, study finds
title.zh: 雨滴是微小的闪电，它们正在腐蚀汽车，研究发现

summary.en: A new study reveals that raindrops can carry significant electrical charges, allowing them to penetrate protective coatings on surfaces and cause corrosion, an effect previously overlooked in understanding material degradation.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，雨滴会携带显著的电荷，使其能够穿透表面的保护涂层并引起腐蚀，这是先前在理解材料降解时被忽视的一种效应。

body.en: The standard explanation for why rain causes corrosion is that water carries dissolved salts and acids to a surface, constant drumming of raindrops abrades whatever protective coating is on it, and oxygen does the rest. Nearly all our tools to prevent this—paints, polymer films, or oxide layers—are built around this idea. But we’ve apparently been missing something important about the rain. A new study led by Zhongyuan Ni, Rüdiger Berger, and Hans-Jürgen Butt at the Max Planck Institute for Polymer Research in Mainz, Germany, has shown that water drops routinely arrive at a surface carrying an electrical charge large enough to punch through an insulating coating. Not scratch it. Not slowly dissolve it. Electrically blow a hole in it, the way a spark jumps a gap. Charged rain The starting point of the study is a phenomenon called "slide electrification," which has only been properly quantified in the past few years. When a water drop slides across an insulating surface like a leaf, a painted wall, a windowpane, or a plastic panel, it strips charge from that surface and leaves an opposing charge behind. The voltages involved are not trivial. Drops charged this way have been measured at up to 9,000 volts. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 对于雨水导致腐蚀的标准解释是，水将溶解的盐和酸带到表面，雨滴的不断撞击会磨损其上的任何保护涂层，而氧气则完成其余的工作。几乎我们所有防止这种情况发生的工具——油漆、聚合物薄膜或氧化层——都是围绕这个想法构建的。但我们显然忽略了关于雨的一些重要信息。德国美因茨马克斯·普朗克聚合物研究所的倪中元、吕迪格·伯杰和汉斯·尤尔根·巴特领导的一项新研究表明，水滴通常会携带足够大的电荷到达绝缘涂层的表面。不刮它。不慢慢溶解它。用电在其上吹出一个洞，就像火花跳过间隙一样。带电雨 这项研究的出发点是一种被称为“滑坡带电”的现象，这种现象在过去几年才得到适当的量化。当水滴滑过树叶、油漆墙、窗玻璃或塑料面板等绝缘表面时，它会从该表面剥离电荷并留下相反的电荷。所涉及的电压并非微不足道。经测量，以这种方式充电的水滴电压高达 9,000 伏。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This discovery about raindrops acting like tiny lightning bolts highlights how much we are still learning about the natural world, even in everyday phenomena. It speaks to the ongoing human quest for knowledge and understanding, revealing hidden mechanisms that impact our material world.
reflection.zh: 这项关于雨滴如同微小闪电的发现，凸显了我们对自然界仍有许多未知，即使是在日常现象中。它体现了人类对知识和理解的不懈追求，揭示了影响我们物质世界的隐藏机制。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: AI could cause global economic downturn, Andrew Bailey warns G20
title.zh: 人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，安德鲁·贝利警告G20

summary.en: The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could lead to a global economic downturn and pose significant cybersecurity risks to financial systems. Andrew Bailey stated that a collapse in the AI sector could trigger a worldwide market correction, and urged...
summary.zh: 英格兰银行行长警告G20财政部长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退并对金融系统构成重大的网络安全风险。安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业的增长崩溃可能引发全球市场调整，并敦促公司为广泛的安全漏洞做好准备。

body.en:
The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could cause a global economic downturn and pose a significant cyber security risk to financial systems.

Andrew Bailey said any collapse of growth in the AI sector could lead to a "future market correction" that spreads worldwide.

In an open letter to finance ministers in the US on Monday, he said companies around the world should prepare for security breaches "involving simultaneous disruption across multiple firms".

Earlier this month, a group of 100 firms , including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, urged countries and groups to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

Bailey told the G20 finance ministers that a combination of highly priced stock markets, increased borrowing by investors, and the growing concentration of money into a small number of major technology companies could amplify any future market correction.

"The issue is not simply that investors are borrowing more, but that leverage is interacting with high valuations and market concentration, in particular the increasing cross-investment between artificial intelligence (AI) companies and hyper scalers, in a way that could amplify a future market correction," he said.

Bailey has called on those in charge of financial security to develop "appropriate steps to support safe and responsible model release and deployment on a global basis".

Bailey, who was writing in his capacity as chairman of the Financial Stability Board international watchdog (FSB), expressed concern about the "volatility" prompted by the effect of energy supply shocks caused by the US-Iran war.

His warning comes several months after UK Chancellor John Healey announced a £100m fund aimed at backing British AI start-ups .

That is part of the government's efforts to grow the country's "sovereign AI" capacity, developing homegrown AI technology to ensure the UK is not dependent on services from abroad.

Ministers want to see companies compete for the funding to help tackle challenges like cutting waiting lists in the NHS and bolstering cybersecurity and defence.

A UK government spokesperson said its' new AI economics institute was working with international partners to build "a stronger shared understanding of how AI is transforming economies around the world."

"The institute is the first government-backed body of its kind focused on AI's economic impact, helping policymakers understand what AI means for growth, productivity, jobs and public services as the technology develops at pace," the spokesperson said.

But there is growing concern that AI companies are increasingly developing models that can easily override the safeguarding systems of banks and financial...
body.zh: 英国央行行长警告二十国集团财长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，并对金融系统构成重大网络安全风险。 安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业增长的任何崩溃都可能导致全球范围内的“未来市场调整”。 他在周一致美国财政部长的公开信中表示，世界各地的公司应该为“涉及多家公司同时中断”的安全漏洞做好准备。 本月早些时候，包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司敦促各国和组织加强网络防御，以免人工智能强大到足以超越它们。 贝利向二十国集团财长们表示，股市价格高昂、投资者借贷增加以及资金日益集中于少数主要科技公司，这些因素结合在一起可能会放大未来的市场调整。 他表示：“问题不仅仅是投资者借入更多资金，而是杠杆与高估值和市场集中度相互作用，特别是人工智能（AI）公司和超大规模企业之间日益增加的交叉投资，从而可能放大未来的市场调整。” 贝利呼吁负责金融安全的人员制定“适当的措施，支持在全球范围内安全、负责任地发布和部署模型”。 贝利以金融稳定委员会国际监管机构（FSB）主席的身份撰写文章，对美伊战争造成的能源供应冲击所引发的“波动”表示担忧。 几个月前，英国财政大臣约翰·希利宣布设立一项旨在支持英国人工智能初创企业的 1 亿英镑基金。 这是政府增强国家“主权人工智能”能力、开发本土人工智能技术以确保英国不依赖国外服务的努力的一部分。 部长们希望看到企业争夺资金，以帮助应对诸如减少 NHS 等候名单以及加强网络安全和防御等挑战。 英国政府发言人表示，其新成立的人工智能经济研究所正在与国际合作伙伴合作，“就人工智能如何改变世界各地的经济建立更强有力的共识”。 该发言人表示：“该研究所是同类中第一个由政府支持的机构，专注于人工智能的经济影响，帮助政策制定者了解随着技术的快速发展，人工智能对增长、生产力、就业和公共服务意味着什么。” 但人们越来越担心人工智能公司正在越来越多地开发可以轻松超越银行和金融保护系统的模型......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence brings both immense promise and potential peril, as highlighted by the Bank of England's warning. Like the testing of character through praise, the development and integration of AI require careful discernment and preparation for unforeseen consequences, lest our ambition outstrip our wisdom. As we navigate...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展既带来了巨大的希望，也带来了潜在的危险，正如英格兰银行的警告所指出的那样。就像赞美会考验人的品格一样，人工智能的开发和整合需要审慎的辨别和对不可预见后果的准备，以免我们的野心超越我们的智慧。...

verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: ‘Scary’: how misinformation and AI hallucinations are infiltrating Australia’s parliament
title.zh: “可怕”：虚假信息和人工智能幻觉如何渗透澳大利亚议会

summary.en: Guardian analysis reveals that dozens of policy submissions across the political spectrum incorrectly summarize real research and invent or wrongly cite sources. This AI-generated material is flooding Australia's government inquiry process, inventing studies and attributing nonexistent research to real academics.
summary.zh: 《卫报》的分析显示，来自不同政治派别的数十份政策提交材料错误地总结了真实研究，并捏造或错误引用了来源。这些人工智能生成的材料充斥着澳大利亚的政府问询过程，捏造研究并将其归功于真实学者但实际上并不存在的来源。

body.en: Exclusive : Guardian analysis reveals that dozens of policy submissions from across the political spectrum incorrectly summarise real research and invent or wrongly cite sources Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s government inquiry process is supposed to help parliament make better decisions, hearing from experts and constituents alike. But Guardian Australia can reveal that the system is being flooded with AI-generated material, which is inventing studies and attributing nonexistent research to real academics and authors. In some cases, committee reports have cited submissions in which the majority of sources appear to be AI-generated “hallucinations”, when large language models (LLMs) invent content that looks real but doesn’t actually exist. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：《卫报》分析显示，来自各个政治派别的数十份政策提交文件错误地总结了真实的研究和发明，或错误地引用了消息来源。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 澳大利亚政府的调查程序应该帮助议会做出更好的决策，听取专家和选民的意见。但《澳大利亚卫报》可以透露，该系统正在充斥着人工智能生成的材料，这些材料正在发明研究，并将不存在的研究归因于真正的学者和作者。在某些情况下，委员会报告引用了提交的材料，其中大多数来源似乎是人工智能生成的“幻觉”，即大型语言模型（LLM）发明了看起来真实但实际上并不存在的内容。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The infiltration of AI-generated falsehoods into parliamentary submissions is a stark reminder of the corrosive power of untruth. Ephesians 4:25 calls us to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another." In an age where AI can mimic human communication, discerning truth and upholding integrity in our discourse becomes ever more critical.
reflection.zh: 人工智能生成的谎言渗透到议会提交材料中，这 stark地提醒我们虚假信息的腐蚀力量。以弗所书4:25呼吁我们“所以，你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话”。在一个人工智能可以模仿人类交流的时代，辨别真理并在我们的言论中坚守诚信变得至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

body.en: Build a home office you’ll actually enjoying working from with tried-and-true upgrades – from inexpensive speakers to a stand that can turn an iPad into a second monitor The best wireless earbuds in the US – tested Sign up for the Filter US newsletter, your weekly guide to buying fewer, better things If you work from home , even just a few days a week, you need more than a laptop perched on a sticky kitchen table. As a tech writer, I have tested dozens of products for my desk setup, and have found some to be totally invaluable.
